name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: URGENT: House GOP just passed THREE bills to ACCELERATE greenhouse gas emissions
body:
__We need to respond: For a limited time, you 'll make 3x the impact - even $5 makes a big difference right now. |

| Peter -- after bringing the country _yet again_ to the brink of a government shutdown, MAGA extremists are wasting no time in resuming their relentless attacks on the environment.

House Republicans just voted to force through a slew of bills aimed at boosting their Big Oil buddies' interests:
* Gutting all federal funding for the greenhouse gas reduction fund, a critical lifeline for underserved communities to benefit from the clean energy transition. (PASSED 209-204: H.R. 1023)
* Prohibiting any attempt to suspend fracking operations, despite problems it causes with water contamination. (PASSED 229-188: H.R. 1121)
* Setting dirt-cheap royalty rates for oil and gas companies to drill on public lands and line their pockets. (PASSED 216-200: H.R. 6009)

**The environmental movement needs to respond in a major way.** But a campaign like this takes resources we just don't have right now -- and after fighting to avoid _massive_ environmental cuts and poison pill riders in the government shutdown fight -- the truth is, budgets are tight right now.

_**We 're turning to our members for help:**_ [The best thing you can do to protect the environment is renew your LCV membership to power our work. And for a limited time, you'll make 3x the impact -- even $5 makes a big difference right now.](https://links.messages.lcv.)

I really hope we'll hear from you today -- because this is a goal that matters. Extremists and their enablers often get away with these kinds of attacks because no one with a megaphone calls them out. Not this time.

body:
We need to speak out now against the GOP’s radical anti-choice agenda.
#
Derek,
Today, the Supreme Court began hearing arguments in a case that could block access to mifepristone — a pill used for medical abortions for the past two decades + is currently used in over 50% of U.S. abortions.
**This is simply**** _bullshit_****.**
With SCOTUS’s hard-right turn, they might use this case to restrict abortion even further — even though a majority of Americans support safe, legal abortion.
And the threat to reproductive freedom doesn’t end with this SCOTUS case. Remember, the Republican running for Senate in PA right now supports a national abortion ban — and so does Tr*mp.
Our freedoms are *literally* on the ballot!!
We need to speak out against the GOP’s radical anti-choice agenda. [**Derek, add your name NOW if you support the right to a safe, legal abortion.**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-abortion-rights-email/?source=em20240326-8862&akid=8862%2E434096%2EuMFlcr)
**[Sign Your Name »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-abortion-rights-email/?source=em20240326-8862&akid=8862%2E434096%2EuMFlcr)**
I’ll say it as many times as I need to, Derek: The right to choose what happens to your body + your future is a sacred, fundamental, HUMAN right. Period.
For now, mifepristone remains safe & 💯% legal in PA. **We will fight this, and we will win.**
Thank you,
John ❤️

Friends,
An incredibly important fundraising goal is quickly approaching. And because you’re one of our most dedicated supporters, we want to take a minute to explain why we can’t afford to come up short.
A few weeks ago, we rolled out a detailed blueprint for how we’re going to build a more representative democracy over the next decade.
What makes that approach unique is that we’re not just waiting for the next redistricting cycle — the fight for fair maps is happening all around us, every day of the year. That’s why we’ve been in the trenches alongside our partners working to secure more victories for our democracy. And our movement has seen some great successes — like the new, fair state legislative maps in Wisconsin, and the newly redrawn Black opportunity congressional districts in Alabama and Louisiana. And that’s just the last few months!
**To put it simply, we are walking and chewing gum at the same time. On an issue like redistricting, that is rare and ambitious — to do it successfully, we need critical resources. We’re setting an ambitious goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the quarter — March 31st — to make sure we’re prepared for this year and beyond.**

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: it's happening right now . . .
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

As I write this email to you, the Supreme Court is set to hear TWO Chemical Abortion cases that will decide whether Chemical Abortion Pills can legally remain on the market, killing hundreds of thousands of babies every year.

**Pro-abortion radicals are FURIOUS about this – and thought they’d have the Supreme Court’s front steps all to themselves!**

But they got some bad news when they saw _Students for Life Action’s**SCOTUS Squad**_ was at the United States Supreme Court.

Just check out the pro-life presence we have at the Capitol right now!
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surlhe-duchtdja-y/)
**First, will you be sure to keep us in your prayers today?**

You never know what radical pro-abortion crazies will do!

After all, these are people who have no problem killing innocent little preborn boys and girls.

**[Second, if you could chip in $10 or even $25 to help us defray the costs of a few gallons of gas to help our young students travel home, I’d really appreciate it](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surlhe-duchtdja-j/)!**

Despite the madhouse it is in Washington, D.C. right now, we have no choice but to be here.

Media elites LOVE pretending that pro-lifers are a small minority, and they were hoping the Supreme Court’s steps would be wall-to-wall with abortion apologists.

We couldn’t let them get away with that – not considering how critical these cases are!

You see, at least **32 women** _(that we know of)_ have been killed by Chemical Abortion Pills after the FDA rushed them to market – not to mention the hundreds of thousands of preborn little boys and girls who have also been killed!

But since Chemical Abortions now make up over **_60%_** of all abortions committed in America, the Abortion Lobby has been pulling strings in the background to try and make this case go their way.

The cases the Supreme Court is set to hear today – _FDA v. Alliance for Hypocritic Medicine_ and _Danco Laboratories v. Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine_ – could not be more critical as Chemical Abortion Pills:

**>>>** Account for 63% of abortions – equaling hundreds of thousands of deaths per year;
**>>>** Are being flooded into states across the country by pro-abortion radicals – even those with pro-life laws; and
**>>>** Are poisoning our country’s water supply as the carcasses of the little babies who are killed by abortion are flushed into our water supply – and water treatment plants don’t treat for trace abortion chemicals or human remains.
We have students and pro-life activists driving in from all across their regions to be in Washington, D.C. with us today.

But I know asking for you to show up and show out at the Capitol for this decision might be too big of an ask for some of you . . .

**[So, if you can’t rally with us on the steps of the Capitol today, can you make a contribution of $25 or even $10 to cover the cost of a few gallons of gas to help all of our students get home after a long day](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surlhe-duchtdja-i/)?**

And don’t forget to keep us in your prayers, as I am a little worried that things could get ugly!

Thank you for everything you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – Since I know seeing droves of pro-lifers gives you hope, _just like it does for me,_ here are some more photos from the court!

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surlhe-duchtdja-d/) [](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surlhe-duchtdja-h/)

Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Hello, Today was a big day in the news cycle. A tragic, yet [possibly controversial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) disaster in Maryland, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. [announced his VP pick](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), the Supreme Court listened to arguements regarding the [abortion pill Mifepristone](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and the [P. Diddy drama](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has continued to unfold. This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, March 26, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Trump Media stock jumps as much as 50 percent before brief halt for volatility**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [THE EPOCH TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
Shares of former President Donald Trump’s social media and technology company jumped about 50 percent on Tuesday in its first day of trading on the Nasdaq before it was briefly halted for volatility. After making its debut, shares for the Trump Media & Technology Group stock, called “DJT,” spiked 50 percent. But it was briefly halted because of the sharp rise before it had resumed trading at around 9:40 a.m. ET. It’s not uncommon for the trading of highly-watched stocks to be suspended when the price increases or plunges too quickly. **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Rep. Boebert discusses Congress, campaign during CD4 grassroots call**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* [U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)expressed frustration over a rushed $1.2 trillion spending bill in Congress, emphasizing the need to prioritize border security. Boebert highlighted her legislative efforts, including drafting legislation to defund sanctuary cities and advocating for securing the border with policies like 'Build the wall, deport them all.'

* She received [endorsement from former President Donald Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and discussed her recent legislation, the Restoring American Energy Dominance Act, which garnered bipartisan support.

* Addressing questions about her [relocation to the 4th District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Boebert reiterated that it was a family-first decision and affirmed her commitment to represent all of Colorado.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Colorado Libertarians will field candidates in 7 of 8 U.S. House seats**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Libertarian Party will have candidates in [seven out of eight U.S. House races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in the general election.

* Candidates will not be fielded in Colorado's 1st District, where Democrat Diana DeGette won with 80.3% support in 2022. Notable candidates include Gaylon Kent in the 2nd District, James Wylie in the 3rd District, and Ike McCorkle as the Democratic nominee in the 4th District.

* [Chairwoman Hannah Goodman](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) plans to run in both the special and general elections to promote the Libertarian Party's visibility. The party emphasizes individual rights, liberty, reducing national debt, and limiting government power as key principles.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Everything you need to know about CD4’s special election to replace Ken Buck**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's Congressional District 4 faces a [significant special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to replace outgoing Representative Ken Buck, whose resignation was accelerated to March 22nd, rather than the previously announced end of his term in January 2025.

* The field for the special election is crowded, with 11 Republican candidates and five Democrats vying for the primary ballot, along with one Libertarian candidate for the general election.

* Notable Republican candidates expressing [interest in the special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) include Ted Harvey, Richard Holtorf, Greg Lopez, Jerry Sonnenberg, and John Fabbricatore, among others. U.S. Rep Lauren Boebert has declined participation in the special election to focus on her primary race.

* Special conventions will be held by each party to select nominees for the special election, with Democrats convening by April 1 and [Republicans convening on March 28](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). This election presents unique challenges and opportunities that could impact the balance of power in the U.S. House of Representatives.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Jensen: Why conservative climate leadership is needed**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* New findings from the [University of Colorado Boulder's Center for Environmental Futures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) suggest that embracing a conservative approach to climate change can help the Republican Party win over voters and ensure a cleaner, healthier future for Americans.

* The[ report ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)reveals that an increasing majority of American voters are concerned about climate change, with views on climate change being strong predictors of pro-Democratic voters in the 2020 general election, especially among Independents and younger generations.

* A conservative approach to environmental challenges involves embracing American innovation, an all-of-the-above energy approach, cutting red tape, and empowering local communities, offering better solutions than the Left's top-down mandates.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

## Fallout Grows from Baltimore Bridge Collapse
The fallout from the shocking [collapse of Baltimore's Francis Scott Key bridge](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGTpCAQBeBfo1lb2DQ4BgSXmM2lF1oI7cgtDhYyQ82_33LjDd97yVfv332-2xDD8_HX7mzKmmbrSnjzLAEHQJqp9WZlRpYtm37oe0WaBtluBjVqVIq8cnxbFI8rESpcbt5pdkq0waBAEhIHMSqNY-eJ5OjVjZzlfiBsSLAPJeXufwrPsvEaP-nNuXNpb6PZSjnORv5pcGpwqrV2mV-F83ntV5Ny9A1Or_MK2wd88LDYWMKeMsOSg38wuBSjPU6GutkCPkFl-HqmCnZJrwLnFg64nCAkoG5warPxRw0xhlMPDYnHbkP8IZVfD_oOAAD__2WDZrg), closing one of the busiest ports in America, spread throughout the Eastern seaboard Tuesday while rescue efforts continued for missing victims. Two people were rescued by Tuesday afternoon, but rescuers were still searching for six others who fell into the frigid water after a container ship hit the bridge--causing the structure to collapse almost instantly, as [captured here on video](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOpDAYg58Guh9BEggpKG4KurmrTleiDBjITUhQkgXx9ium3sqWrE-W_e85PLWxxi2_9YYuzX7QYzIHBk5MEhODyKduBhh4jq6SVVWLRkier52SleYNr1QzTzO4qtXIXmMpW960SrdNbjpWMlFyJktVN0wVkxBcTXUrRo1KCpaJEpNJPhT_vXFpxWwvfyAUo99y260p7THjvzLWZ6w_z7PYoruzjPVw9BUz1juct3y8TmShY6KIA452-N2CdADFZKylzcRo3EJ6TgiUVtBL22Q2H0BvXPQKZlpAo7dW7xG04kYJB8KV1ps8QW_nz7sr0ONRva-_f7Y8dNN-GmtNbGQmymXTxn4mpB8P_Q4AAP__1VZ5ng) President Biden said the federal government would pay to rebuild the bridge, but in the meantime, shipping into the Port of Baltimore is stopped. Plans to divert cargo shipments [to other East Coast ports ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQAL8GOk54WYxdULzG3b02pYVhORNhYwF3Uf4-utRppplipPm4r3eXcjof_91BtseyOt_Ti1YlwAjAFXmwkQhIcbKDGQaNIxrFd0uTRxVkHKShAApR6W2cIng9jojzxJMFCSgVGDnrEeZbQFRz0BN6R4NBYCgppF7q7bOks-8U83d5Ub35cvBs996vxtQ_BguDpe-0p5zfjsGyPVs6qTUGC2pt1KQEudaFL29epfYmtuo8iViqiC7n8uwi1nKIzeWejlJJbDWFBwlfcnZXIwYLrzZcXynn1EbDUD4Ol36TvP855ycAAP__djpmNA)are underway, but cargo delays are expected.
## Trump Media Has a Big Debut
Trump Media & Technology Group stock, on its first day of trading on the NASDAQ [exchange as DJT, ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FugzAQQL_GbEZwPjAZPHRhS9eOyPiO4NTgCC6x-vdVOnd70hue3td1uvqY4n779Bs7WfLkg8QXT0aD1YATVuQWZmBTsWtt23bYozXV6gzN7WDR80wegRY7mJ6bofczYduxqaKDBrAxYJtL18OlJkRzoW7A4Lm1CAobpij5qO857rLykn7yi4865K1KbhV5nMp8KBgVjKWUOsznzuV8ewXjGxWMcjy3h6a76FNy-NZyPGXVZw7RJ03FBy2Hp7jfFIzV4ehRYkrx7K3C5rb5mP5y8u_8bwAAAP__UGhcSQ)closed at $57.99 per share, a 16% gain from Monday. Overall, the company ended with [a market value of $7.8 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0Lty6yAQgOGnQR0abhJWQXEadT5tSs2Ki7UJAg-s7fHbZ5I6_V_8831ctytgxnL7D2d0lOoGnvAZN82V5cpsZgguxaiiHqKTVsrJzMbq4XDeCLD7RUS5iH1a5kuyEsRutE9-F6AGdEooI7SyYplmtYzBGL2E6WI8RGmNYkbEgFTb-Fmx0BFTftdnbKOv55DdQXTvTP9jamVqTVig-Di-4aj1p2BqLfHVmVqpPc5759QedPBePULmnar_4r1C6xwLT9g68QBvXhOnBgHLjUutrZistONBZx6aC_cX5ox9tsyI2wmYf1foT5jvAAAA__-w-WU8). Former President Donald Trump's stake is valued at $4.6 billion, though his shares are said to be locked up for six months. Early trading had shares as high as $75.21, nearly a 50% gain, before settling back by the time the market closed. [Analysts say many](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNkf2-cAweOiSLV07osv5HNwaTMFJ1L-v0rnj01ue3sdlulDKab290yK-xjIR1_SQySpwCnDCNvgoAmJb8cYZ02GPzraz1z2IHoPjazQ0XIc4xoFQ-tB1kTlymzxoQG3B6bHrYTwFRDuGbkAmMQ6hQS0h1bKfPkta6ywx_5SH7CcuS5v9XOt2NPatgXMDZ9pWeR4v9YK9Js7SwLnu92VTi4REqu73OqujcKKsVjoCfaujFv5SRvfBMYI1DplMcMyWeSQb7TA60u3uw_ZMOaejdw3q20Ip_2XUf6f8BgAA__9Xc2Lh) investors in DJT are small-time traders pushing the stock up for short-term profit and support of Trump himself, and not professional long-term investors.
## RFK Jr. Picks Nicole Shanahan for VP
Independent presidential candidate [Robert F. Kennedy Jr.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GSrCAURL8GMiy8oIwBwUvM5qUbWgxc9M4gWsiONX-_5cabdXUHfc7Xfbo7SpTn_25FW-M2OV_pjZMSYAToSfNgIyKg4mhb07ad7rVRfLEqevWIfVDQ3QYPg4QYby6qhwvm6jhZkKClAiOHroehCVqrIXQ37R22RgPTEgPVrTTPjXJdMKbP9sbS-G3lyS617gdT_xiMDMbzPBv_ODKex7UzGK_IYCzxJZ5FlO-cKc9idRXFC3PG8BF7wYMC5iouFAYjLzbsJ6VER2-YlvPqKP3-1T_tfwIAAP__WYRbmA) named Nicole Shanahan, a lawyer, philanthropist, and campaign donor, as his running mate Tuesday. Kennedy said Shanahan understood technology, would protect the environment, and provide a voice for millennials and Gen Z. Shanahan, a California-based attorney, is the ex-wife of Google co-founder Sergey Brin and has never run for a political office. Until recently, she was a Democratic donor but said [the party "lost its way"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAUAL8GNlvweAYzMHTxlq4dLQzPMRU2kU2D-vdVOme9k066r9t88ymn4_7pd3J1LbMPNT1pVh2YDnBGHt1KBKQ4OWmkHFCjUXxzMEo5GmWXMQxKyEByXVYNxloiMejIkwMBKBQYYQcNto-IysZhxOBJGgSGgmKq5ey_SzrqRmv-LU86-1B2nt1W6-Ni6oPBxGBqrfXLEl6OwXRQu16wnDl2P1cX_OGj7_SoQWpp-Onio6Wc06UNQ3Hffcr_2fp28i8AAP__3_xQ3A) and suffered from "elitism." Kennedy [needed to name a vice presidential ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAQQH-N3RENwxhMQXFNulx7pcXHkHDB2HLYRPn3q2y95dNrnt6_y3LxpZZ2_etXdj1vi4-9PHlRAo1AWmhMLjMjq5GdNFJOpMmo8eZCAphZ2WT1pNDbPEGMRiOamTIwjcUhIIFCA3bSaE-JSNk0zRQ9S0M4EHAqfTtO_7fS-o1zfW9PPk5xW8fqbr3vj0H9GfA84NnvjV-Pj_rA0UusPOD5yHcRthDe4s6tcXqL5y6Or9ZKu4rVdxY6sE6GgYI3ybIhaSHMEaSXIYOZxsOl_VVqLQ9tBoLr6kv9Sei_DvkOAAD__4oOYAY)candidate to qualify for the presidential ballot in many states.

"Inosculate" developed from a combination of the words "into" and the Latin word "osculare," which means "to provide with a mouth or outlet." "Inosculate" is a verb describing the act of joining by intertwining — like how ivy inosculates with tree branches. Some living creatures inosculate in a symbiotic relationship, depending on each other to survive and thrive. ...

body:
This initiative is not merely about economic reform.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7a8d47d285a3436692203ca47eeb9842&_e=5m4jlErjE6Z0hIYpRAO1L-wIqJ8NEC5pTjtyNsRudDHJyOW4-rqq93OmAqG2hwAJTh75RJybP8tATeSdP4_pL8hpj4Y-If1j0znhafeBrg9nQkG_rniTqCDxyi1scgadlDGr-EA6fRcKXYNSWXZ8MlffM2HPVHPAZC6HI6REsgDeUqRMgfJoWdt4B7gdyWfY5m3okHZ7ZYRzKNLETsscFOvuaHdD94l-cx2N-maMNRo-eXaD-QuduvxIjD5HPbQDxr2aEsYprC4WeUWxWXPGNIZSnQ3L33Sxvdo-rhVb5fKM7IcFt9EdCaidTJIxhXeLUM5LU7JKNubFIWRi-v5PZRdz-4BALJADlzeQBQ6MvpfD1QFs-cRD1dZ7htndu_4EBkWR5wD0W_kuogVJW0uxYA%3D%3D)
---
| | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7a8d47d285a3436692203ca47eeb9842&_e=5m4jlErjE6Z0hIYpRAO1L-wIqJ8NEC5pTjtyNsRudDHJyOW4-rqq93OmAqG2hwAJTh75RJybP8tATeSdP4_pL8hpj4Y-If1j0znhafeBrg9nQkG_rniTqCDxyi1scgadlDGr-EA6fRcKXYNSWXZ8MlffM2HPVHPAZC6HI6REsgDeUqRMgfJoWdt4B7gdyWfY5m3okHZ7ZYRzKNLETsscFOvuaHdD94l-cx2N-maMNRo-eXaD-QuduvxIjD5HPbQDHCvgqlrgGik-aZhxPMSmK_QkYShDsyRK7mmN80fcqwREqRxajED7ogZdfYkdxXZaOUU4pQt0MK3ZkqPJefpQB2xm7aEJcisCpounf2GzQa09Ky4AK96EdWcL1vg6A5R0P40oXr9xLNWQAon_JZwAUg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

Nicole will upend the Establishment narrative and cement the 2024 Election as a 3-Way Race! name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: Putting it all together
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Daniels For Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
Endorsements are something candidates for office talk about all the time, but what do our endorsements say about what kind of leader we will be in office? In my case, I think my endorsements say a lot about my values and priorities. You see, I believe that defeating Scott Perry is important, but who replaces him is just as important. I believe we need to elect a Democrat whom we KNOW shares our values, and who will fight for them in Congress.
My endorsements reflect not just my values, but the values of Democrats across the district. I hope that you agree, and that you will consider joining these organizations in supporting my campaign with a contribution before our critical end of quarter deadline on Sunday at midnight.
Make a contribution now by clicking here! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
I am proud to be endorsed by the National Organization for Women, the Latino Victory Fund, CASA in Action, and Second Generation.
I have spent most of my adult life fighting for a woman's right to choose. I started the fight as an activist with the National Organization for Women (NOW), and have stood with NOW ever since. Together, we've fought not just for a woman's right to choose, but also for economic justice, racial justice, LGBTQIA+ rights, and an end to violence against women.
As the only woman of color running for the Democratic nomination in PA-10 , these are not just the priorities I've fought for, many of these issues reflect the challenges and obstacles I've faced throughout my life and my career, and in Congress, I will work hard to remove these barriers so that others do not have to walk the same path.
I am proud to be endorsed by NOW in this campaign, and if these are your values too, I'm asking you to make a contribution to support our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
I'm not just the only woman of color in this Democratic Primary, if elected, I will also be the first Latina to represent Pennsylvania in the U.S. House . My family immigrated to the United States when I was young. I am proud a proud American who is also proud of my Venezuelan heritage. I believe in the American Dream because my family and I lived it, and I want to make sure that the American Dream is alive and well for future generations of Americans, whether natural born or immigrants like me.
I also understand the immigration crisis in unique ways. I'm not just an immigrant myself, I spent much of my career as an immigration attorney. I understand what we need to do to fix our broken immigration system, and I understand that doing so is important not just for those seeking a better life here, but also for our country, our economy, and our future growth and prosperity.
For all of these reasons, I am proud to have the endorsement and support of The Latino Victory Fund, CASA in Action, and Second Generation.
These organizations are dedicated to advancing values and priorities to which I have dedicated much of my life. These aren't just my values, they are OUR values as Democrats, and in Congress I will fight hard for them.
I can't do that without your help. These organizations have stepped-up to support my candidacy because of my Democratic values, and my long history fighting for those values as an activist, attorney, and elected official and I'm asking you to do the same.
The PA Primary is just a month away, and our biggest fundraising deadline so far is this Sunday at midnight. Can you rush a contribution of $25, $50, $100, $250 or whatever you can afford to my campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thank you for your ongoing support for our campaign!
With gratitude,
Shamaine

subject: All I had was a pen

body:
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots. I think that anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
I won’t ever forget it, Peter.
Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.
I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.
And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick.
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.
I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.
I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.

Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them. I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate. This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House. I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously. - If you’ve stored your info with ActBlue Express, we’ll process your split contribution to Bob Casey and Ruben Gallego instantly: - - - - - - Thanks for your support. As we gear up for one of the toughest elections of our lives, it means a lot to have you behind me. Ruben

name: Team Harper
subject: The real reason we ask for your support
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
Without you, Hill can’t compete against the establishment.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1116%2E62735%2EMGBG57)
Hey Peter,
We know we’ve asked for a lot of support lately, but there's a good reason: Hill doesn't accept a _single cent_ of donations from corporate PACs.
Because in an election year where spending from outside groups has already surpassed $318 million, Hill knows the last thing we need is another bought-and-paid-for candidate running for office. That’s why he's committed to running a grassroots-funded campaign, which means **we really do rely on supporters like you to stay competitive!**
**[With our campaign’s end-of-quarter deadline approaching this Sunday, will you rush any amount to help Hill hit his $25,000 fundraising goal? Every dollar we receive is critical to our work to elect Hill, so _no donation is too small._](https://act.hillharper.com/go/914?t=2&akid=1116%2E62735%2EMGBG57)**
As a political outsider, Hill believes in running a different kind of campaign — one that doesn’t take marching orders from the wealthy and well-connected. That’s why he turned down $20 million from one of AIPAC’s biggest donors last year — on the condition that he drop out to challenge Rep. Rashida Tlaib — to run a clean, grassroots campaign for Senate.
Sure, it might not be the easiest way to fund a winning campaign. **But Hill is committed to doing things the right way, and that means proving that he can’t be bought, bossed, or bullied into compromising his principles.**
Which brings us to the reason we’re reaching out for your support. March 31st marks our end-of-quarter reporting deadline, when we have to disclose our fundraising numbers to the Federal Election Commission.
These numbers will be shared publicly, and they'll be scrutinized by news pundits, local journalists, and even our opponents. **We need to show everyone that Hill's momentum is only growing stronger — and we can’t do that without your support!**
**[If you're able, please consider contributing $5 or any amount before the end-of-quarter deadline. Every donation will go a long way to help us showcase Hill's momentum on our next FEC report!](https://act.hillharper.com/go/915?t=3&akid=1116%2E62735%2EMGBG57)**
**[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/914?t=4&akid=1116%2E62735%2EMGBG57)**
Thank you for chipping in!
\- Team Harper
* * *
**[DONATE »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bax_hh_email?refcode=bax_hh_emailfooter&t=5&refcode2=1116_62735_MGBG57&akid=1116%2E62735%2EMGBG57)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:

Hill Harper for Michigan

Peter,
Last night, I delivered my annual State of the State address from Owatonna High School. I was proud to report that the State of Minnesota is strong and getting stronger every day because we’re investing in what matters most – our children and our future.
When voters elected our DFL majorities and gave us a historic mandate for action, we promised that we wouldn’t let a moment go to waste working to make Minnesota the best state in the country to live, work, and raise a family.
From securing universal meals for our students to making the largest investment in public education in our state’s history to increasing teacher pay and expanding mental health resources, we’re delivering on that promise. And our work extends far beyond the classroom.
We made a billion-dollar investment in affordable housing, outlawed conversion “therapy” for LGTBQ youth, enacted common-sense gun safety measures, codified protections for abortion and fertility treatments into law, and so much more.
Minnesota is showing the rest of the country what it looks like to be a state that puts children first, stands up to bullies, and lifts everyone up. But let me be clear: None of our work would be possible without you and the support you give us.

We also are demanding the Police Department release Ibarra's initial arrest report, as required under Georgia law.

Laken Riley's tragic apparent murder by an illegal alien has put the national spotlight squarely on the _dreadful human toll_ of Joe Biden's politically-driven, open borders policies!

**And it is fair to ask...how many more must die, Mr. President?**

Judicial Watch's historic multi-year lawsuit in San Francisco, challenging its "sanctuary" policy that led directly to the shooting death of _another_ young American woman at the hands of an illegal alien, led to serious reforms in that city.

And [with your support now](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67615&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2), we will use the legal system and the courts to expose the truth about Laken Riley's murder..._despite the many political forces that wish to suppress the facts about what happened_.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67615&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Judicial Watch has successfully challenged state and local governments over tuition benefits for illegal aliens, and investigated other policies and programs that improperly use taxpayer funds to support illegal aliens with our borders.

And we are now suing the Biden administration for public records related to their criminal failure to secure our borders and their cooperation with radical groups that are part of the massive Soros open-borders network.

[Your contribution now will help us](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67615&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) make sure we can continue to pursue our _independent investigations and lawsuits_ that fight for the American people's "right to know" and the rule of law...including our laws against illegal immigration.

[I hope you will help us today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67615&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) in fighting for the security of our borders, for the rule of law, and for our nation's sovereignty.

We're prouder than ever before to be Democrats. It's more clear than ever before just how important it is to ensure that President Biden wins another term. They know that President Biden is a true fighter for progress. They'll do anything to stop him from winning another term. | | | | | Peter, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect. One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors. **And now we know: Sinema’s out.** This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her. I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign. [**Please, split a $5 or $10 donation between Blue Amp Action and my campaign. Whatever you can afford can help us build the team that’s going to win in Arizona. **** Peter, I’m Bill — Mad’s new deputy campaign manager. I’m so thrilled to have the opportunity to work on such a great campaign for PA and I’m honored to be introducing myself to Mad’s friends and supporters! I hear great things about this grassroots team.

I look forward to getting to know you more as we get deeper into campaign season, but right now with our end-of-quarter deadline around the corner, I wanted to make sure you had a chance to pitch in.

We set a goal to raise $15,000 before our FEC public filing deadline. This seems like a big goal — and it is! Our opponent, the NRCC, and GOP mega-donors are waiting to see if we underperform in this report to decide which PA races to invest in. And we can’t let them choose Mad’s! [**Help us keep the NRCC out of Mad’s district and donate right now >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81747121/463404935/1461890534?amount=25&refcode=03272024_md_eoq_fr_2&refcode2=f134930f-47ec-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTM0OTMwZi00N2VjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9ZtxIbr3wvoFYjrzKARrf47j9Z-_SIyI9bD62C431TM=)

| | Over my years in this work, I’ve come to the conclusion that Georgia needs a big, powerful, and strategic force that can truly affect the public policy, leadership, and culture of our state. Simply having good intentions when our opponents have war chests, armies, and institutions will not yield results. Frontline is being built as the Kingdom-minded instrument of policy transformation—strong enough to go toe-to-toe with our adversaries' well-funded machines. That’s why we have aggressively grown this organization to what it is—building our lobbying team, communications support, Church Ambassador Network, and more. _By God’s grace, the results are there to show for it!_ [**In the midst of our most intense legislative session yet, our focus has not been on fundraising, and, with a Q1 deadline rapidly approaching, we are, frankly, needing your support.**** ****_Can you help us raise $5,472.38 to help us reach our goal?_**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/1d1eaeb27b6b84cbc3d6b838967d376c/44483) _This legislative session, the results are evident. So far, Frontline - in partnership with our legislative allies - has..._
* Endorsed 67 bills
* Testified in Committee at least 58 times
* Drafted 22 pieces of legislation
* Provided the largest pro-family lobbying group in the state, a resource and “go-to” on every piece of legislation at the Capitol
* Become the premier conservative outlet for honest updates on what is transpiring under the Gold Dome
* Delivered a MAJOR victory for School Choice – providing hope for roughly 20,000 students and building momentum for the future
* Banned Central Bank Digital Currency
* Passed RFRA out of the Senate
* Amended legislation to now include provisions to Save Girls' Sports, Protect Girls' Bathrooms and Locker Rooms, Prohibit Sexual Indoctrination in our Elementary Schools, Ban Puberty Blockers, and More.
* Fought every form of gambling expansion
* And so much more...

A host of initiatives await a final vote, and, tomorrow (Sine Die), our full team will be at the Capitol from early in the morning until after midnight before celebrating Easter Weekend. **Because we don’t want to be asking for money as we consider the great victory Christ achieved for us on Easter, can you help us reach our Q1 goals?** **_To purchase a ticket to Frontline’s upcoming Run2Win Conference - where we will discuss our wins and build our movement - [CLICK HERE.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/9afc4b91cfb0dacac3d6b838967d376c/44483)_** **_To make a TAX-DEDUCTIBLE donation of $25, $250, $1000, or more to help us close this legislative session strong and continue building this organization -[ CLICK HERE.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/7b28b512175811a7c3d6b838967d376c/44483)_** We are running full speed through the end of Sine Die. Yes, we expect obstacles (some of which we already know), and, yes, we know that there will be some disappointments. However, we will leave every ounce of effort and strategy all on the field. After session, however, things won’t slow down. April 8th is Frontline Policy Action’s 3rd District Debate **[(PURCHASE TICKETS HERE).](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/b4273a1e04992f2cc3d6b838967d376c/44483)** April 26th - 27th is our Run2Win Conference - with nationally known speakers, major organization partners, and opportunities to build the Georgia conservative movement[ ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/d48e6750c180089ac3d6b838967d376c/44483)**[(PURCHASE TICKETS HERE).](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/43b205a4ae49d2bac3d6b838967d376c/44483)**[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/91c01eace7e4b3e5c3d6b838967d376c/44483) May 6th is our next C3 event in Gibson **[( SIGN UP HERE).](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/02c1be071de3e23fc3d6b838967d376c/44483)** And, on May 21st, Frontline Policy Action endorsed candidates will be elected in the Georgia primary elections. In the midst of all of that, we have exciting developments for our Church Ambassador Network, legal initiatives, new communications announcements, election planning, and, yes, 2025 Legislative Session preparations already underway. [**Georgia needs you standing with us on the Frontline! With Easter Weekend coming up, we are working to meet our Q1 goal by midnight on March 28. Can you chip in TODAY to help us reach our ****_$5,472.38 _****goal?**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/1281f416efe787813947229f28c3afba/480ddc2da573d461c3d6b838967d376c/44483) Now is not the time for the forces of Kingdom-transformation to shrink back. Your help as we build this organization, fight for our values at the Capitol, speak truth in the public square, awaken God’s Church, and equip believers to engage in the upcoming elections is essential as we stand against those who hate us. Ready to Win,

clean_body: “I refuse to let my two little girls grow up in a country where they have fewer rights than I did.” | | | | | = Hi Peter, We are excited to share our latest endorsement: Whitney Fox for Florida's 13th Congressional District. = When we first met Whitney, we were blown away by her expertise about the people of her district. She has spent so much time connecting with voters; working to genuinely understand their deep needs and what they’re looking for in a Representative. She is a rising star – and the definition of an empathetic leader. We could not be prouder to support her. = Whitney is running against Congresswoman Anna Paulina Luna, who is a self-described "pro-life extremist” and MAGA Republican. Here’s a look at Anna Paulina Luna’s record: ❌ Supports a national abortion ban, without exception of rape, incest, or the life of the mother. ❌ Opposes any meaningful gun regulations and regularly posts photos on social media glorifying AR-15s. ❌ Supports shutting down the government at the expense of Florida voters and the economy. ❌ Continues to push conspiracy theories around the 2020 election and has written a children’s book about how the 2020 election was “stolen.” Whitney has stated that she will not sit back as her two little girls grow up with fewer rights than she had when she was their age. “I believe my support for reproductive healthcare and abortion rights is clear. At bare minimum, we need to codify Roe into federal law. This should be coupled with efforts to expand access to required care so women do not have to travel to other states, and protect facilities from those that seek to regulate them out of existence.” - Whitney Fox A constitutional amendment protecting abortion is set to be on the statewide Florida ballot in November. _**MI-03 has one of the highest numbers of young voters of any district.**_ Last year, we won in large part because of our DIY youth mobilization program, driven largely by peer-to-peer organizing. It was a clear demonstration that when young voters are empowered and engaged directly by those who genuinely serve their interests, remarkable things can happen.

There are a lot of organizations out there that say they're working on the youth vote, but no one can mobilize the youth vote better than the person who works to serve them every day. I've been serving young people my entire career–from working in the summer program at a local housing shelter to serving as a volunteer in a youth ministry program. Now, as a member of Congress, I make youth outreach a top priority–from reading to elementary schools to hosting town halls specifically designed for youth, I make sure to show up.

Because, when it comes to winning elections, it's not just about asking people to do something FOR you by asking for their vote; you've got to make sure to do the work first, and then people will want the kind of representation you offer. But getting our message out and organizing the vote takes time and money. Last year, we ran an almost _**50% volunteer-led operation**_ , but we still need materials and staff to organize the volunteers.

Hi Peter, Our nation is in dire need of a change from AOC and the far-left's divisive and extremist politics. AOC and her allies put their radical ideology over the well-being of everyday Americans. subject: I know you’re busy, so I’ll be brief
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
As I began my day this morning, I found myself thinking about my recovery journey and the GIFFORDS community.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240327-1-30&t=1&akid=7842%2E3935704%2EQFclqi)
---
Hi there, it’s Gabby Giffords. I know that you’re busy, so I’ll try to keep this brief. But I wanted to reach out to you personally because as I began my day this morning, I found myself thinking about my recovery journey and the GIFFORDS community.
Thirteen years ago, I was shot in the head while meeting with constituents in Tucson, Arizona. I’ve been in recovery every single day since. I often think about my recovery the same way I think about our movement to end gun violence: some days are more difficult than others.
It hasn’t been an easy journey for me, but even on my darkest days, I’ve refused to give up hope. Today, I encourage you to take a moment to renew your hope that we can and will have a future someday where everyone is safer from gun violence.
This work is challenging. Believe me, I feel that struggle right alongside you. But the fights worth having are rarely easy. That’s why we can never, ever give up.
I know my team has been reaching out to you about our March FEC fundraising deadline. It’s coming up very quickly, and we have a lot of ground to make up if we’re going to reach the big goals we’ve set to start the election year off strong and continue our lifesaving work.
[**I really need you with us today. So please, can I ask you to chip in $3 to GIFFORDS PAC before our critical FEC fundraising drive comes to an end this Sunday?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240327-1-30&t=2&akid=7842%2E3935704%2EQFclqi)

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

I believe that America stands at a crossroads. Our individual freedoms, the nation's respect for the Constitution, and the legacy of our Founders are all enduring relentless assaults. Shifts in our society threaten to dilute our nation's character while biased media and divisive politics amplify it greater than ever.

The people that this impacts the most are not you and I-_It is our future generation._ Our children and grandchildren are being taught that that is their skin that defines them, not the content of their character. They are being taught that our nation's history is something to be ashamed of. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=363a923f3ee84c108090f9e3993fa1d2&_e=WGMYd8-s-GNWRFXGwP9NUjgMGTdjuXR-rkG8UykS8KhoagFnIPVNI0TKHdeFOc2XBz5CskpFuPA8cJljtvmgJyNH2oFdkXLgQ9SJ879Z0HrRsrbXY24SqHtZsy3CaDWypwzS0hyfmLYEsoD_GnKBpFEdJtMO9JmksekijG389_xK-0x6WFhYebP9tWeZFBvXJa-Go7T-MS5jh-4J8tglqt3w89YThRFj7le36p3wYsOtkVBYGaeUBxNLOefvwQdeypf74q8Zbc8rHNR_LqqM3omBKSyzJsQ86oUEfFFWXFcifx63RPF8LrNn0qeSIA3U2AksmMgXWB9DLB-x-cIuz0zPCW7pqlfnsU9XmpnXZ9Ffm2g7c0euSPcIhl9LbMlNkTmIqsG9wpXHiuD_nJKfQQ%3D%3D) Candidly, it just doesn't make any sense.

But, I believe we can change this. I believe we can build a future that upholds the values of faith, liberty, community, and life - a future where all Americans are free to pursue their ideas, goals, and faith.

This won't be possible without your involvement. I've created a simple pledge; a way to align us all around a set of shared beliefs. [I want to invite you to take the Common Sense Pledge.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=363a923f3ee84c108090f9e3993fa1d2&_e=WGMYd8-s-GNWRFXGwP9NUjgMGTdjuXR-rkG8UykS8KhoagFnIPVNI0TKHdeFOc2XBz5CskpFuPA8cJljtvmgJyNH2oFdkXLgQ9SJ879Z0HrRsrbXY24SqHtZsy3CaDWypwzS0hyfmLYEsoD_GnKBpFEdJtMO9JmksekijG389_xK-0x6WFhYebP9tWeZFBvXJa-Go7T-MS5jh-4J8tglqt3w89YThRFj7le36p3wYsOtkVBYGaeUBxNLOefvwQdeYALhrC2XUxojlgVp6Y6hvUl73cpBYL1zZv3BFDGQLdz2DsLI7cAbDtudFMjIHMDkUTavSuhA2w_Yak1eaEtGSpSYC8skSINORWZCi3Pc-WRLHXySMKBvwlH8Y-3lRQkEC4E6TXqlEacGRDYPxRXjOw%3D%3D)

We cannot bring about this necessary change without you. By signing this pledge, you are committing to uphold the principles our nation was founded on and teach them to the next generations. **Just one person can make a difference, and it can start with you.**

This is not a passive petition; it's an active pledge to uphold the common sense values that shaped our great nation.

Sign the Common Sense Pledge today using this secure link: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/common-sense-pledge/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=363a923f3ee84c108090f9e3993fa1d2&_e=WGMYd8-s-GNWRFXGwP9NUjgMGTdjuXR-rkG8UykS8KhoagFnIPVNI0TKHdeFOc2XBz5CskpFuPA8cJljtvmgJyNH2oFdkXLgQ9SJ879Z0HrRsrbXY24SqHtZsy3CaDWypwzS0hyfmLYEsoD_GnKBpFEdJtMO9JmksekijG389_xK-0x6WFhYebP9tWeZFBvXJa-Go7T-MS5jh-4J8tglqt3w89YThRFj7le36p3wYsOtkVBYGaeUBxNLOefvwQdei7Ec4gkwfc3RAKIWnvwJs3IqeA-ro2bdg1DOqPzJxCNbXVGKttHeEc9mJqkQBipum8-7lcx23ub4PKVryPvSFATuRwwJ7ape6WVwZdGW7NxosqFU4T3UNSGgWaPZRPDbD4u8z0Y8PVdsN-z43qnXBA%3D%3D)

Together, we can shape a future that respects our shared history, protects our hard-earned freedoms, and prioritizes common sense. Your involvement is critical - are you ready to take action?

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman

Our own John Bisognano — we call him “Biz” — sat down with Punchbowl News recently to discuss the state of maps across the nation ahead of the critical 2024 elections.
**A lot was covered — but here are three big takeaways that cover just how[your generous donations to All On The Line](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81759341/463438611/972822063?refcode=don_aotl_redlite_email_marfun_email_Punchbowl&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgyMjA1ZTEwLTUzZWMtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=hQykdFvJPQSpEgfXGoUeYZeZM_EcC8Fs_7iO_vNPLZo=) have been put to work:**
1. Biz discussed our work across the Deep South, including our recent victory in Alabama, saying, “We’ve been able to be successful in making [many] states, mostly across the South, more representative of the people of that state.”
2. New York just updated their maps, and Biz explained to Punchbowl that the New York state constitution did its job and resulted in fairer maps across the board.
3. And you know we’re always looking ahead to the future, so Biz pointed out the active court cases in Utah, Florida, and South Carolina as places where our affiliates are actively aiming to challenge the current, gerrymandered House maps.

We’re always grateful for how Biz can easily break down exactly what we’re working on here at All On The Line — and why the work we do matters.

I’m a fourth-generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.
But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where I’m now raising my family.
**I ran for Congress because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream and protect the fundamental values of our democracy – and I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent, helping Democrats flip the House blue in 2018. **
_Now, I’m ready for my next challenge:_ taking on Ted Cruz. I know it won’t be easy, but I also know that Texans deserve so much better than Ted Cruz’s cynical partisan politics. **Everything Ted Cruz does is for Ted Cruz – when I’m in the Senate, everything I do will be to help people like you. _While we didn 't get the result we hoped for in this month's California Senate primary race, I'm still in Congress serving out my term as the Congresswoman for California's 47th district. I plan to continue using this Substack account to write about politics and policy, through posts like the one you'll see below. I hope you'll stick around! _
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fc16e38c-ef86-4bfb-a16d-2ec9b456fa23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Like many Americans, my kids have been asking: **Is Congress really going to ban Tiktok?** The House voted the other week on a bill that could lead to a ban of the app, and now it lies in the Senate's hands. I voted against the potential ban, and I want to explain why.
Let me start by saying I have real concerns about data privacy and safety on TikTok, and we must take these security concerns seriously.
But I voted no on this bill because legislators should make careful policy--not rushed, out-of-touch decisions that don't engage Americans.
The way I see it, being in Congress is a teaching and learning job.
**It 's our job to **_**learn**_**from experts about the threats TikTok and other tech companies pose, and assess that risk.** It's our job to ask the tough questions and make sure we make informed, thoughtful policies.
**But we also need to** _**teach**_**the American public about what we learn.** There's a reason Americans were calling congressional offices non-stop the week this bill was up for a vote. Millions of Americans rely on TikTok to promote a business, make a living, or find community. Taking that away from people without a thorough and thoughtful conversation isn't the right move--it only further erodes peoples already low trust in our elected officials.
While the threat posed by TikTok and the Chinese Communist Party's ability to influence Americans is unique and dangerous, my concerns about data privacy don't start and end with TikTok. Congress must take data security seriously, whether that data is owned by a foreign company or a U.S. owned one.
Our conversation about TikTok is far from over. Thanks for following along!
Katie Porter

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Derek,

I wanted to share some reflections on the events that have transpired in
the three weeks since Steve Garvey and I advanced to November’s U.S.
Senate general election.

What they mean for our campaign. And even more importantly, for the shared
struggle for our democracy as a whole.

Because make no mistake:

When Donald Trump saluted the violent January 6 insurrectionists from the stage
of his Ohio campaign rally...

When his campaign played their recording of the National Anthem sung in chorus
over the jailhouse telephone to paint the traitors as martyrs...

When Trump called the rioters who beat Capitol and Metropolitan Police officers
— some within an inch of their lives — “hostages” ...

When he did all that and more, the plain truth of this election became even more
apparent.

Trump and his far-right extremists are no longer trying to erase what
happened on January 6th. Their goal is to glorify the seditious acts. And
if they do not get their way in November, their goal very well might be to
overthrow our democracy completely.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=mar2024_abs_em.AiZCIe&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240327_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6100%2E5257348%2EhlBeqp ]That’s why we need to fight back. So before I go any further (and trust
me, there has been far more that’s transpired) — I’m humbly asking you to
pitch in a contribution of any amount before my campaign’s FEC deadline on
Sunday.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

The truth of Trump’s extremism is right in front of us, and now more than
ever, we cannot falter in this final effort to consign him to the dustbin
of history for good. We cannot let up. Not when we have been fighting for
this long. Not when we are this close to vanquishing him for good.

Since our election, Trump has called immigrants “animals.”

He has said that Jewish people who vote for Democrats hate their religion.

And he has attacked me — repeatedly — because he believes I represent
everything he despises — just as you do — people who still believe in
small-d democratic ideals and the rights set forth in our Constitution.
You know, the values he abhors.

The rest of the party he just completed taking over with the ousting of
Ronna McDaniel at the RNC has the entire MAGA Republican Party playing
from the same sheet of music.

The National Republican Senatorial Committee launched a digital
advertising campaign calling me a “liar.”

Republican dark money donors incorporated a new super PAC called “Strike
Out Schiff.”

And Trump has continued to attack me on social media.

November, and if we fail to reach our FEC fundraising goal by this Sunday,
Trump and his allies will pour even more gasoline on the fire. So before
they do, will you contribute
$3 or any
amount before my deadline?

Thanks for taking the time to read this longer email. With the volume and
intensity of GOP attacks, we can’t allow it to become white noise. Each
and every one of Trump's allies' smears threatens to take hold among
voters — and we must fight back with the truth.

Thank you,

Adam

# Biden's Swamp Reign:
### Why Trump's Return Is a MUST for America
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/redirect/d29bb22c-d437-4e80-8d4d-3a3c5dc934ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

---
In the swampy quagmire of Washington, D.C., Joe Biden's presidency has become a textbook example of the entrenched elite protecting their own interests, exemplified by his unwavering defense of his son, Hunter Biden. It is a tale of corruption and the deep-seated influence of the political establishment!
From the moment Joe Biden took office, promises of transparency and integrity were quickly overshadowed by the murky dealings of his own family. The Hunter Biden scandal, with its shady business dealings in Ukraine and China, has cast a dark cloud over the Biden administration, raising serious questions about ethical lapses and the abuse of power.

Yet, instead of addressing these concerns head-on, Biden and his allies in the mainstream media have resorted to the same tired tactics: deflect, deny, and dismiss. Any mention of Hunter Biden's questionable activities is swiftly labeled as baseless conspiracy theories or partisan attacks--an insult to the intelligence of everyday Americans who can see through the smoke and mirrors.

But the truth cannot be obscured by the swamp's murky waters. Hunter Biden's cozy relationships with foreign entities, enriched by his father's political stature, are a blatant example of the corruption that runs rampant in Washington. It is a swamp that protects its own, shielding the elite from accountability while ordinary Americans are left to fend for themselves.

Enter Donald J. Trump--the disruptor, the outsider, the voice of the forgotten Americans who have been ignored by the political elite for too long. Trump's presidency was a breath of fresh air--a beacon of hope in a sea of corruption and deceit. His unrelenting attacks on the swamp struck a chord with patriots across the nation who were tired of business as usual in Washington.

The choice is clear: between a president who puts America first and fights tirelessly to drain the swamp, and a career politician who embodies everything that is wrong with Washington. Trump is a true patriot--a leader who is willing to take on the entrenched interests and restore power to the American people.

As Biden's presidency continues to be mired in controversy and scandal, the calls for Trump's return grow louder by the day. He is the only one who can truly drain the swamp, dismantle the deep state, and deliver on his promises to Make America Great Again.

In the battle between the swamp and the patriots, there is no room for compromise. It is time for America to stand united behind President Trump and reclaim our country from the clutches of corruption. With Trump at the helm, America will once again be the shining beacon of freedom and prosperity that the world admires.
I was happy to have been asked to be a part of the making of this new book. It is driving Democrats CRAZY! Why? Because the truth hurts.

My good friend (and fellow Mississippian) just released [CLONING DONALD TRUMP.](https://substack.com/redirect/2008e5fc-8276-4bb7-9838-13d88a06743a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) It is a MUST READ for all Conservatives and according to Col. Rob Maness, a must read for all Americans.

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81763737/463450378/-1682838858?refcode=mw_em_240327_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzJiNWNhZC01N2VjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hByfeapS38vf9qaWEyXewCSdlpwdGYTfRMkcIOi9mTc=) Derek, **Yesterday, oral arguments took place in the U.S. Supreme Court case regarding the abortion pill mifepristone.** Surprisingly, the Supreme Court signaled it is likely to reject this challenge to mifepristone. When candidates look to run for office, the plain fact is, they have to have funding. That’s because reaching out to voters _isn’t cheap_. Everything from printing yard signs to running ads on TV and online requires careful budgeting. Lots of politicians look to corporate PACs and special interests to back their campaigns. That’s the route Marsha Blackburn takes — and it shows! That’s the easy route. _But I’m not one to take the easy way out._ Right now, I’m facing a critical end-of-quarter deadline. We set an ambitious $370,000 goal, and I’ll be honest: We’re falling way behind. **_[But I’m betting that this grassroots team will step up. Can I ask you to pitch in any amount right away?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81766330/463457314/274086332?refcode=ea.2687bc74-5bec-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ms=ea.2687bc74-5bec-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjg3YmM3NC01YmVjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dVQXJe4ySKiJSjiov0ASSpSfHQSrJyYG7SmFwQScd98=)_** **Y’all, I don’t take a CENT of corporate PAC money. It may make financing our campaign harder, but it’s the right way to win.** Because when I’m in Washington, I want you to _know_ that I’m only accountable to PEOPLE — not big-money donors. | | Friend, I’m sure by now you’ve heard that on Tuesday, the Supreme Court heard another case that will have a major impact on abortion access across the country. This time, the Court heard a case about restricting access to mifepristone, a medication that is used in over half of abortions in America. If the Court decides like it has in past abortion cases, it would make it _substantially_ harder to receive necessary reproductive healthcare. We’ve seen this Court’s aggressive anti-abortion stance before in _Dobbs_ , and it has fundamentally altered healthcare for millions in this country. From the families having IVF access restricted in Alabama to women being forced to flee Texas to end a dangerous pregnancy, we’ve seen the fallout from this far-right Court for years now. It’s sick: people are being forced to go to the courts for approval to end a pregnancy, even when their lives are in danger. **[**Restricting abortion access puts people in dangerous situations and if the Supreme Court upholds this decision, more people will be put in harm's way. Finally, after decades of conservative mega-donor influence, the far right has eviscerated one of our most fundamental rights: the right to choose. If you think this Court has gone too far and we must reform the Court, please chip in $10 now so we can keep working to fight to pass these critical reforms.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81768214/463461900/444630146?refcode=3-28-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1MjJmZWIwLTVkZWMtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=vAO1Pt1XOG3HCA8UbXJK0txW0wsYDfgQOiBF3OLFbqg=)** This Supreme Court is corrupt, and it’s no secret. Justices are jet-setting with billionaires and rubbing shoulders with conservative mega-donors all while casting aside the duties of their position. Restricting abortion access even further is just the next step in a long line of decisions influenced by their Republican billionaire benefactors. We no longer have an unbiased judiciary, and we’re all feeling the impacts. **[The Supreme Court is supposed to be above partisan political influence, but it’s becoming increasingly clear that it isn’t at all. As conservatives continue to have significant sway over the Court’s decisions, it’s more important than ever to protect abortion rights throughout the country. Please contribute $10 now and we can work together to fight for an unbiased, independent judiciary.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81768215/463461901/444630146?refcode=3-28-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1MjJmZWIwLTVkZWMtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=vAO1Pt1XOG3HCA8UbXJK0txW0wsYDfgQOiBF3OLFbqg=)** This corrupt Supreme Court continues to impede on our reproductive rights and put people’s health in danger, and this mifepristone case is a prime example of that. **[**If you want to work towards an independent, non-corrupt Court, please chip in $10 today. Our rights are on the line.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81768216/463461902/444630146?refcode=3-28-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1MjJmZWIwLTVkZWMtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=vAO1Pt1XOG3HCA8UbXJK0txW0wsYDfgQOiBF3OLFbqg=)** Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action

Friend, with Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene filing a motion to remove Rep. Mike Johnson as Speaker of the House, the chaos in Congress is reaching new heights.
The harmful actions from extremist Republicans only threatens to add more confusion and division to our government, making our communities less safe.
Now friend, I need to be clear with you: if my opponent wins this rematch for Texas' CLOSEST congressional campaign, the chaos will just get worse.
I'll remind you that Republicans will have to deal with only a 1-seat majority soon, so every race is critical in taking back the House.
As your representative for Texas' 34th Congressional District, I'm deeply concerned about what this can mean for our communities.
We can't afford to have more distractions and political games while vital issues affecting South Texas, like healthcare, education, and job security keep getting ignored by the MAGA majority..
South Texas deserves a representative who will prioritize the needs of our community over partisan gamesmanship.
I am more than ready to continue being your advocate in Congress, but I can't do it alone.
Friend, reaching our End of Quarter goal is critical to protect our values and put the focus back on serving the people of South Texas — will you help our people-powered campaign with a donation today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240327_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
STOP MAGA EXTREMISM [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240327_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
With gratitude,
Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.

While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.
