name: Dr. Cornel West for President 2024
subject: DNC Declares War on Independence: Fight Back!
body:
The New York Times has recently reported the Democratic Party's efforts to restrict ballot access for third-party presidential candidates. Fight back for independent voices and independent choices beyond the duopoly -- it's time to put people before profits.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc_war_on_independence?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_declares_war_on_independen&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, **The New York Times has recently reported the Democratic Party's efforts to restrict ballot access for third-party presidential candidates.** We are not taken aback by the establishment's maneuvers to thwart the participation of third-party and independent grassroots candidates in the electoral process. Unlike our adversaries, our campaign is devoid of super PAC backing and corporate sponsorship. Instead, we are powered by a genuine movement of the people, which evidently poses a significant enough threat to provoke such tactics. **The irony of a party, self-proclaimed guardians of democracy, working to eliminate third-party participation in the electoral process cannot be overstated.**
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc_war_on_independence?amount=24&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_declares_war_on_independen&n=2 "DISMANTLE THE 2-PARTY SYSTEM DONATE $24 TODAY") [DISMANTLE THE 2-PARTY SYSTEM DONATE $24 TODAY](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc_war_on_independence?amount=24&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_declares_war_on_independen&n=2)
---
**Our campaign believes in the sanctity of the electoral process and the right of every citizen to have their voice heard through a fair election.** This pattern of behavior is not new, but a continuation of a disconcerting trend aimed at consolidating power by any means necessary, reminiscent of past actions to manipulate the electoral process against candidates like Bernie Sanders. Such actions are not only anti-democratic but also indicative of a deeper systemic issue within the current political system, where the interests of the few are prioritized over the fundamental rights of the many. The effort to limit ballot access, under whatever pretext, is a direct assault on these principles, more damaging to the fabric of our democracy than any alleged external threats.
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc_war_on_independence?amount=24&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_declares_war_on_independen&n=3 "DONATE NOW TO END THE DUOPOLY ") [DONATE NOW TO END THE DUOPOLY ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc_war_on_independence?amount=24&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_declares_war_on_independen&n=4)
---
**The suppression of voter choice, especially under the guise of legal challenges, reveals a troubling inclination towards authoritarianism that we vehemently oppose.** We stand in opposition to the establishment and advocate for the dismantling of the two-party system that perpetuates corporate greed, spreads hate, and misinformation, promoting division among us. Our movement seeks to unite rather than divide, aiming to overthrow the interests of the wealthy elite that have profited immensely at the expense of the working class, particularly during times of crisis._****_
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc_war_on_independence?amount=24&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_declares_war_on_independen&n=5 "TAKE A STAND FOR INDEPENDENCE DONATE NOW") [TAKE A STAND FOR INDEPENDENCE DONATE NOW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc_war_on_independence?amount=24&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_declares_war_on_independen&n=5)
---
**In the face of these challenges, we remain morally and ethically consistent.** Our volunteer base is fully informed and undeterred by these revelations. We are committed to continuing our fight for a more inclusive, just, and loving society. Our campaign, inspired by brother West's vision and REVOLUTION LOVE, represents a diverse coalition of individuals united in their pursuit of truth, justice, and love. **We invite you to join with us.** In Solidarity, **Dr. Cornel West
** 2024 Independent Presidential Candidate _P.S. Peter**, this isn't just about us - it's about protecting the right to vote, the very foundation of our democracy. Let's prove that people power can triumph over money. [Donate $24 now](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc_war_on_independence?amount=24&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_declares_war_on_independen&n=6). Together, we can dismantle the two-party system and build a democracy that truly represents us all.**_
---
**Let's collectively cultivate a vision that's truly progressive – one that honors our fellow human beings, both at home and across the globe.**
---

After 40 years of “trickle-down economics” that vacuumed money from the poor and middle class to the rich, it’s time to reverse course.

Today’s minimum wage of $7.25 an hour is cruel. No one can live on that poverty wage, and no one can live on a $15 minimum wage. Not only is it cruel to working people, but it’s cruel to taxpayers who spend huge amounts of money on food stamps, Medicaid and a host of other services and bureaucracies to make up for poverty wages.

It’s time to make the minimum wage a living wage for **EVERYONE**. Here in the three counties of the 10th District, that means $21+ for a single wage-earner, according to MIT’s living wage calculator. Please Google it and see exactly what that means for Cumberland, Dauphin and York counties.

[Support my campaign, and let’s get this done.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81771218/463468929/999241479?amount=10&source=RC_EM_FR_WL_240327_1_1&refcode2=e134b2bd-61ec-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&contactdata=pieuOLvMt4Di6Pr+yiXrNe/+PeIBGo4VqbVym258rVuT25XDwxJXcBVBB4jj7vfL&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMTM0YjJiZC02MWVjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntdhIzGl3E50R_p-0MvFK9wdSntFi8Mrubg0JsLa1GM=) | | **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81771220/463468931/999241479?amount=10&source=RC_EM_FR_WL_240327_1_1&refcode2=e134b2bd-61ec-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&contactdata=pieuOLvMt4Di6Pr+yiXrNe/+PeIBGo4VqbVym258rVuT25XDwxJXcBVBB4jj7vfL&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMTM0YjJiZC02MWVjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntdhIzGl3E50R_p-0MvFK9wdSntFi8Mrubg0JsLa1GM=)**

People tell me they don’t measure our economy by how well Wall Street is doing. They measure it by whether **EVERYONE** can afford to put food on the table, a roof over their heads, and gas in the car to get to work.

A living wage makes sense for **ALL** workers, including those now earning the national “tipped minimum wage” of $2.13 an hour and even high school students working at fast food restaurants.

Some say that requiring a living wage for servers will cause restaurants to close. California has a $16 minimum wage for **ALL** employers. Does anyone think California doesn’t have restaurants?

Some say students should earn less because they are living at home. What about students living in poverty? Why shouldn’t **EVERY** student earn enough to avoid taking out loans for college or trade education, or for a reliable car of their own, or for a down payment on their first home?

When low-income people get more money, they spend it, and that helps every part of our economy. They can – and will – buy all kinds of essential goods and services for their families.

Of course, a change of this magnitude will take a few years to phase in, but NOW is the time to start. We should create a living wage that adjusts for the cost of living in different communities. AI can do that in less time than it took to read this email.

clean_body: | After 40 years of “trickle-down economics” that vacuumed money from the poor and middle class to the rich, it’s time to reverse course. Today’s minimum wage of $7.25 an hour is cruel. No one can live on that poverty wage, and no one can live on a $15 minimum wage. Not only is it cruel to working people, but it’s cruel to taxpayers who spend huge amounts of money on food stamps, Medicaid and a host of other services and bureaucracies to make up for poverty wages. It’s time to make the minimum wage a living wage for EVERYONE. Here in the three counties of the 10th District, that means $21+ for a single wage-earner, according to MIT’s living wage calculator. Please Google it and see exactly what that means for Cumberland, Dauphin and York counties. = | | = People tell me they don’t measure our economy by how well Wall Street is doing. They measure it by whether EVERYONE can afford to put food on the table, a roof over their heads, and gas in the car to get to work. A living wage makes sense for ALL workers, including those now earning the national “tipped minimum wage” of $2.13 an hour and even high school students working at fast food restaurants. Some say that requiring a living wage for servers will cause restaurants to close. California has a $16 minimum wage for ALL employers. Does anyone think California doesn’t have restaurants? Some say students should earn less because they are living at home. What about students living in poverty? Why shouldn’t EVERY student earn enough to avoid taking out loans for college or trade education, or for a reliable car of their own, or for a down payment on their first home? When low-income people get more money, they spend it, and that helps every part of our economy. They can – and will – buy all kinds of essential goods and services for their families. Of course, a change of this magnitude will take a few years to phase in, but NOW is the time to start. We should create a living wage that adjusts for the cost of living in different communities. AI can do that in less time than it took to read this email. = | = – Rick | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Friends of Rick Coplen | =

Peter,
Did you see the grant program that Jena launched last month? She announced a grant program to reimburse counties for security expenses.
This includes security cameras, cybersecurity infrastructure, and more. Jena’s work as Secretary of State has helped Colorado continue to run gold standard elections that set an example for states across the country.
“Make no mistake: We are talking about threats against election infrastructure (and) election workers, we are talking about election workers being afraid to do their job, because Donald Trump has lied over and over and over about how elections work.”
- Jena Griswold
In the face of Donald Trump and far-right extremists’ election-denying conspiracy theories, Jena is doubling-down to ensure every single Colorado voter can make their voice heard and every election worker is safe while running elections.
Now, all 64 counties in Colorado can even further improve election security. Jena will continue to take all necessary measures to ensure fair and free elections and increase participation in our Democracy.
Read the full article about this new grant program here. [https://coloradonewsline.com/2024/02/28/colorado-secretary-of-state-launches-election-security-grant-program-amid-2024-threats/]

Peter,

I'm so excited to introduce myself! I'm Marissa, Kim's campaign manager.

As campaign manager, it's my job to make sure this team is built for success. So I want to tell you a little about our upcoming FEC fundraising deadline and why it's so important for this team.

I joined this race because Kim embodies everything I believe elected officials should: she has a kind heart, the drive to do what's right, and the compassion needed to do the most good for the most people.

Unfortunately, Republicans are eyeing this district, hoping to flip it red and replace Kim with someone who will put party over people. **I refuse to let that happen.** That's why I'm doing everything I can to ensure this team has the resources we need to win in November.

This FEC fundraising deadline of 2024 is our first big test, Peter. If you believe in Kim like I do, then I'm asking for your support to help us hit our ambitious $40,000 goal before midnight Sunday.

| | Over the last few weeks, I've been inspired by my colleague Sarah Long sharing her story, so I wanted to come on here and share a bit of mine as well. My story started in 2008 when I volunteered for Obama's campaign, and **I was instantly hooked.** The buzz in the air and the possibility of change invigorated me, so I dropped out of a pre-med college program in 2009. # Campaign Newsletter
# Note from River
Former President Obama once said _**“Change is never easy, but always possible.”**_ I carry this message to serve as hope and inspiration to everyone in El Paso County.
I have spent the last 6 months reaching out to voters and delegates in El Paso County through phone calls and in-person events. I’ve heard many of the issues that affect us at home and I will take these issues with me to address in Congress. In less than 2 weeks, delegates will be voting on which candidates to move forward to the primary process. I am more than confident I will have the support of our community to make the ballot.
I will continue to build a coalition that will lead us to victory this November. Each and every one of you keeps this campaign moving. I hope to see you all and speak to you at one of my future events.
Thank youRiver

It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. | | Fellow American - My name is Nancy Mace. I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table. Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it. Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted. Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices. Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth. But here’s where I need your help – the rich continue to run Congress because they have the funds to do so.But I have you... I have no friends in Washington, Fellow American because I don’t play into the bull**** swamp and I can’t be bought. The only people I work for are the American people, I learned a long time ago that I have to fight for the things I believe in, and I believe in America. There was a time in my life when I never thought I would graduate high school, let alone serve in Congress. subject: Campaign Updates, Videos, & More! 🇺🇸
body:
| | | | | |
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=08964f6b0c&e=0a12281e0e)
# First Campaign Video is LIVE! 🎥
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e9e76dca6b&e=0a12281e0e)
I am excited to announce that our FIRST campaign video is officially LIVE! 🚀
🎥 It's been a labor of love, and I couldn't be prouder of the incredible team who poured their hearts and souls into making this video happen.
This video is more than just footage; it's a glimpse into my vision, values, and commitment to bringing Western Maryland’s conservative voice to D.C. and flipping Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans in the General Election this November.
Click the link below to watch and share with everyone you know! ⬇️
| [CLICK HERE TO VIEW VIDEO](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=94cf7ae66a&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Special Message from
# Speaker Newt Gingrich 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=fb995eb3c9&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m absolutely thrilled and deeply honored to share this very special message from Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich. His support means the world to me, and I’m grateful for his confidence in my vision and leadership. Together, we’ll continue to work tirelessly to bring Western Maryland’s conservative voice to Congress and flip this seat in November.
Thank you, Speaker Gingrich, for your endorsement and belief that we can make this happen for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District! 🇺🇸
| [CLICK HERE TO VIEW VIDEO](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=9c9528ca1e&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Media Coverage 📰
Our campaign has ignited a wildfire of momentum, capturing the attention of media outlets far and wide. With each passing day, our message resonates louder, drawing in supporters and spreading our message and campaign to wider audiences.
The media frenzy surrounding this race is palpable, with various newspapers and websites covering our campaign. To delve deeper into the buzz surrounding our campaign and to stay updated on the latest developments, click below to visit our website and explore the plethora of news articles capturing our progress in our campaign for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District! 🇺🇸
| [CLICK HERE FOR RECENT NEWS](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b18a8cf1ec&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Fundraising 🙏🏽
With absentee ballots set to be mailed out by the state of Maryland starting on or after March 30th, we are facing a tight deadline to ensure our message reaches every voter in our district. To make this happen, we must raise a minimum of $25,000 by April 15th in order to get our materials out in time.
Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. Here is what our campaign needs help with in the next 30 days to get over the finish line:
1. **Postcard Mailing:** $3,000
2. **Yard Sign Purchase:** $1,000
3. **Mailer for Absentee Voters:** $6,000
4. **Door Hangers:** $1,000
5. **Texting:** $2,000
6. **Digital Advertising:** $10,000

We understand that these are challenging times, but the future of our district and country is at stake. We need your help now more than ever. Please consider donating today to help us get through the primary election on May 14th here in Maryland.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution:
[**rocaforcongress.com/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=75f3a7c112&e=0a12281e0e)
The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives and continue advancing our conservative agenda. 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=eb84432975&e=0a12281e0e)
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f647ce4f56&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=4a55198572&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=767b677c2b&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6e5b9e78c9&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=089a01b0e9&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=646dab8c0d&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=13acad62ca&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=58f4f6abf9&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=9ae8b6cf6a&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f30d999c3a&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e508feacf8&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b92402090b&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=036cf256cf&e=0a12281e0e)
|

body:
Becca Balint has that courage.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81779000/463484462/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOGFmYjU0NC02OWVjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2B_GiSBylUpm0x6cSKHEFUkzKyJDQAolgu3e-QkzcNI=&emci=5a23416e-5bec-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=d8afb544-69ec-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=43402272) | Hi Peter, This is Senator Bernie Sanders. I was proud to endorse Becca Balint for Vermont’s at-large congressional seat in 2022, and I’m proud to stand with Becca today as she officially launches her re-election campaign. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81779001/463484463/126023764?&refcode=E7712-20240327-Bernie-Image-EndorsementElected&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOGFmYjU0NC02OWVjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2B_GiSBylUpm0x6cSKHEFUkzKyJDQAolgu3e-QkzcNI=) Becca made history in 2022 when she became the first woman and the first openly LGTBQ+ person ever elected to serve Vermont in Congress. clean_body: | Peter – Last week, I introduced the Destroy Zombie Guns Act, a bill that ensures gun disposal companies actually destroy entire guns , rather than a part or two. It’s a commonsense solution to something that should never have even become a problem – but pro-gun groups are furiously attacking me over it. Just look what they’re saying on social media: Look, Peter – this response is completely disproportionate. It would be comical if it weren’t so dangerous. But here’s what I know: When extremist, pro-gun groups are attacking you for common-sense legislation, you’re doing something right. Because they only push this hard when they think our movement is a threat to theirs. The gun lobby and pro-gun extremists have been after me for years. In fact, their attacks ramped up when I made it to Congress – and they get more defensive every time someone like you joins me. I know we can’t count on them to stop. They’re relentless, because they know their attacks will lead to donations for my opponents and everyone who wants me gone.But you can count on me. I ran on the hope that we can have elected officials who will do what’s right. As long as I’m in Congress, I’ll always do that. Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ecd0073db795400e955631708d0d6a8d&_e=MiNQ8tHRBtwY8KfzSx3-Cc1sCBRkFEbrZHsu5t9rYzLKBZA7ACnEpxm8ZSrZRTqRNYQF3VqiIUjpkyk40cD4f1hG_D4bxeBNToUqeJOq4kx77CslDsgw0ggJAe61wpDFPp-EPyG0qa95PUfw3txQTWdnOMbVIdtZdpo1YqyLabSZqqE3OI2bik-sRRUkBplFMpNYhkmm1Yn5vvi3UoFN-_nkYbYpjfRCuYcEhvESBSThL4OnFi2FMZzAbfYjpm664qZTUpylWB02N4SWgdQTSZ8ReyrpoBHaG15x97xbZnC2QG5kqYtiG6R8v1lMRAV3kX4lVkAzc-18s9MshNRLk0zpp6jLgcRb9W3j9pGZpKOXTC9iYdPEcVsC0ehXmTPrZBB-T06SHNhkJiIIs02Xgg%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friend,

It’s Tamie Wilson, and I want to make this quick: I am on the ground in Washington, D.C. joining the Women’s March and the protests in front of the Supreme Court to make our voices heard and fight for our rights.
[](https://eqjdwl.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjUwODYzOCxcImxcIjoxMTY5ODU0NjQ0OTAwMzUxODAsXCJyXCI6MTE2OTg1NjUwODgwNzA5ODE2fSIsInMiOiJkMjlkNzJiMmM0NWJlNGVjIn0)

---
|

As the Court heard arguments from ultra-conservative lawyers urging them to unilaterally block access to medication abortion that has been used for the last 24 years. We made sure that the media and every politician around understood that we won’t go back. We refuse to let politicians strip away our freedoms and our rights.**We will NOT go quietly, and we will NOT sit down and shut up.

** Medication abortion has time and again been proven safe and effective through extensive research and data, as well as with decades of use with FDA approval and under the guidance and supervision of physicians and medical professionals. In short, there is NO justification for what the far right is trying to do except exert EVEN MORE control over women’s lives and bodies.

WE WILL NOT BE FORCED BACK IN THE KITCHEN BAREFOOT AND PREGNANT!

subject: Judicial Watch Files U.S. Supreme Court Amicus Brief on Abortion Drug Mifeprex/Mifepristone
body:
Judicial Watch announced recently that it filed an amicus (friend of
the court) brief in the U.S. Supreme Court regarding the abortion drug
Mifeprex (Mifepristone, formerly known as RU-486).

[alt_text]

[*****]
March 27, 2024

[article-image]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67626&L=31738&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYW1pY3VzLWJyaWVmLWFib3J0aW9uLWRydWcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNvcnJ1cHRpb24rY2hyb25pY2xlcyZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=6e1dfb8d3ffff58eea429f28ccf6e61c77e94aeaaeb9f999f7f2a9aa0e5a6a0e]

“Make no mistake, this is a dangerous drug. We have known since
its inception that the abortion drug Mifeprex is potentially dangerous
to the mothers as well as the intended victims, the unborn babies,”
said Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton. “Extremist abortion
politics in the Clinton, Obama and now Biden administration are
putting pregnant mothers at risk. Let’s hope the Supreme Court
recognizes that an extremist abortion agenda has overcome the rule of
law at the FDA.”

subject: Why the mainstream media is failing
body:
Questions swirl about the future of the industry. One headline in the Atlantic asks, "Is American Journalism Headed Toward an Extinction-Level Event?"
Join the Sun and restore American journalism.

| | | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=107299e689184d4e971199eb6f9f16db&_e=qshbe-GBRFYvJ6GHa95skJkrOyoCXuDrZsiN8YeYJEQgqBmpBMXfeQ6Q_rE1okWSalFBPaMEzC4OeTvfaCiEWb87izHHlv-M3vjFacrNxbE_v81vNeAp8qa3o2BhmqwXBOpxOpGrQp5Wr-s7nxW5yxBWmXiOg5qAQF4DXJv0mNDsTPgHv_01M53Mh8R8ZiLwAvS3tU-S7hiSMx5sUb0i6Z9-QpaZw1tj-6__uwyl1WfqqP83TPW7EZk1dsIH4jV9R8fg6Ovxg7keNPvNwHExYnw-5Et8EXqmkmW0HlGsHqHeg24EpNnrp6ry4gssQlDhDHDr-s8BTqKdjgA96TCSbJ4CB1Mmu9zzXtSmgoOKtYdMQkAHLBgwo6toffk-Am5r)

| | _Dear Reader,_ _It's no secret that the mainstream press is failing the American people dismally. And yet, I'm optimistic about the future. Americans are waking up, and the movement to save American journalism is gathering speed._ _It is the honor of my life to help lead the charge by returning the famed New York Sun to the center of the national conversation. Below is a note I just shared with my fellow citizens on the recent anniversary of our return to publication. I hope you'll take a moment to read it and consider joining our fast growing movement._ _We need you. We need every patriot to stand with us._ *** As we mark this year the second anniversary of The New York Sun's return to national daily publishing, reports on our industry are dire. Layoffs are everywhere. Last month, Los Angeles Times fired 20 percent of its newsroom. The Wall Street Journal reduced the staff of its Washington bureau. NBC News, ABC News, Time magazine, Sports Illustrated, National Geographic, Insider, NPR, Vox, Conde Nast, and CBC all announced layoffs. Buzzfeed News, Pitchfork, and the Messenger shuttered their doors completely. A Northwestern University study released in November finds that nationally, newspapers are closing down at a rate of 2.5 a week, mostly weekly publications issued locally. Questions swirl about the future of the industry. One headline in the Atlantic asks, "Is American Journalism Headed Toward an Extinction-Level Event?" Predictions are dire. Uncertainty is rampant. The mood, in general, is grim.
---
| | [JOIN THE SUN](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=107299e689184d4e971199eb6f9f16db&_e=qshbe-GBRFYvJ6GHa95skJkrOyoCXuDrZsiN8YeYJEQgqBmpBMXfeQ6Q_rE1okWSalFBPaMEzC4OeTvfaCiEWb87izHHlv-M3vjFacrNxbE_v81vNeAp8qa3o2BhmqwXBOpxOpGrQp5Wr-s7nxW5yxBWmXiOg5qAQF4DXJv0mNDsTPgHv_01M53Mh8R8ZiLwAvS3tU-S7hiSMx5sUb0i6Z9-QpaZw1tj-6__uwyl1WdSbfV2yi-pM8-5NwsVwQ9INfgPLZAWQmHgun1sMqDJPMtzI2fJHrhBUiJAwQ13cZ9dKt7zrZ77xVdb1AV7zULtsWyxSd7pyLmE05LS49oAKoJH9IRntjjHybN2T-Axm4OMyoOXNPN_pZ5fTHN7lAv1)
---
| | It would be a mistake, though, to ignore the fact that human nature is a constant. The uniform desire - nay, need - to be informed has obtained since the birth of civilization. “The newspaper is an article of primary necessity," the Sun's pioneering 19th century editor, Charles Dana, once said. "You must have your breakfast, but you must have your newspaper too." Indeed, news consumption on the whole remains high. It seems, then, that what appears as a contraction is in fact a form of correction. The market is offering a vigorous reminder of its most enduring truth, that a newspaper's primary customer is its reader. It's a principle that in many quarters has faded over time, more so amid the industry upheaval that has in recent decades accompanied the digital revolution. This and other factors have led to a realignment of priorities at many of our country's most storied publishers. They have come to serve other masters. First among them are advertisers. The temptation is understandable. They've long paid the newsman's bills. The Sun, we must confess, played a role in introducing this model. As the first penny daily, it sold for a fraction of the price of competitor papers. It pioneered front-page advertising to offset the lower subscription price. Later, Charles Dana was described as being "barely tolerant" of advertisers and dreamed of a newspaper that was wholly supported by readers.Other papers have come to prioritize the politics, leading to a deliberate effort to downplay important stories of public interest. There have been newspapers acquired as status symbols by billionaires and deployed as ideological playthings. Others have been designed or repurposed as government organs. The Telegraph in Britain, a fine newspaper, is now at risk of being swallowed up by the United Arab Emirates. There are even calls for government funding of newspapers and journalism en masse, a terrible idea, and fully incompatible with the democratic vision of a free press. At the Sun, we hold the view that the opportunity remains greater than ever for any newspaper that is compiled with a view to serve the reader above all. In the words of Charles Dana, a newspaper "must correspond to the wants of the people. It must furnish that sort of information which the people demand, or else it can never be successful." Our aim is for every interaction with the Sun to inform, educate, inspire, and uplift our readers. To do battle on their behalf to protect the "social freedom" that our republic is in danger of entirely losing. So that "every intellectual plant grows vigorously and bears its fruit without hindrance from any quarter." We’ve been encouraged by the public reception so far. Join the Sun and restore American journalism. | | | | | | Dear Reader, It's no secret that the mainstream press is failing the American people dismally. And yet, I'm optimistic about the future. Americans are waking up, and the movement to save American journalism is gathering speed. It is the honor of my life to help lead the charge by returning the famed New York Sun to the center of the national conversation. Below is a note I just shared with my fellow citizens on the recent anniversary of our return to publication. I hope you'll take a moment to read it and consider joining our fast growing movement. We need you. We need every patriot to stand with us. * As we mark this year the second anniversary of The New York Sun's return to national daily publishing, reports on our industry are dire. Layoffs are everywhere. Last month, Los Angeles Times fired 20 percent of its newsroom. The Wall Street Journal reduced the staff of its Washington bureau. NBC News, ABC News, Time magazine, Sports Illustrated, National Geographic, Insider, NPR, Vox, Conde Nast, and CBC all announced layoffs. Buzzfeed News, Pitchfork, and the Messenger shuttered their doors completely. A Northwestern University study released in November finds that nationally, newspapers are closing down at a rate of 2.5 a week, mostly weekly publications issued locally. Questions swirl about the future of the industry. One headline in the Atlantic asks, "Is American Journalism Headed Toward an Extinction-Level Event?" Predictions are dire. Uncertainty is rampant. The mood, in general, is grim. | | | | It would be a mistake, though, to ignore the fact that human nature is a constant. The uniform desire - nay, need - to be informed has obtained since the birth of civilization. “The newspaper is an article of primary necessity," the Sun's pioneering 19th century editor, Charles Dana, once said. "You must have your breakfast, but you must have your newspaper too." Indeed, news consumption on the whole remains high. It seems, then, that what appears as a contraction is in fact a form of correction. The market is offering a vigorous reminder of its most enduring truth, that a newspaper's primary customer is its reader. It's a principle that in many quarters has faded over time, more so amid the industry upheaval that has in recent decades accompanied the digital revolution. This and other factors have led to a realignment of priorities at many of our country's most storied publishers. They have come to serve other masters. First among them are advertisers. The temptation is understandable. They've long paid the newsman's bills. The Sun, we must confess, played a role in introducing this model. As the first penny daily, it sold for a fraction of the price of competitor papers. It pioneered front-page advertising to offset the lower subscription price. Later, Charles Dana was described as being "barely tolerant" of advertisers and dreamed of a newspaper that was wholly supported by readers.Other papers have come to prioritize the politics, leading to a deliberate effort to downplay important stories of public interest. There have been newspapers acquired as status symbols by billionaires and deployed as ideological playthings. Others have been designed or repurposed as government organs. The Telegraph in Britain, a fine newspaper, is now at risk of being swallowed up by the United Arab Emirates. There are even calls for government funding of newspapers and journalism en masse, a terrible idea, and fully incompatible with the democratic vision of a free press. At the Sun, we hold the view that the opportunity remains greater than ever for any newspaper that is compiled with a view to serve the reader above all. In the words of Charles Dana, a newspaper "must correspond to the wants of the people. It must furnish that sort of information which the people demand, or else it can never be successful." Our aim is for every interaction with the Sun to inform, educate, inspire, and uplift our readers. To do battle on their behalf to protect the "social freedom" that our republic is in danger of entirely losing. So that "every intellectual plant grows vigorously and bears its fruit without hindrance from any quarter." We’ve been encouraged by the public reception so far. I'm pleased to report that our readership has grown by more than 300 percent over the past year. Paying memberships, sustaining the Sun's journalism, have grown by 500 percent. We've added new, exciting talent to our newsroom. Daily we hear from young people who are hopeful about making a career of journalism. We're not guided by the subjective and parochial analysis of what might be decreed "fit to print." We're a paper that for nearly 200 years has borne the promise to "shine for all." That means relentlessly seeking the benefit and welfare of our readers and all of the public which we serve. Nothing less will do for the Sun. So may I take this occasion to express, on behalf of my colleagues as well as myself, my sincerest thanks to each of you who have joined us over the past year. And to declare that our arms are held open to all Americans who have yet to make the Sun their home. Yours sincerely, | | | Dovid Efune** Publisher, The New York Sun |

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: All I had was a pen
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots. I think that anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
#
_Mandela Barnes and The Long Run are proud to support Ruben Gallego for Senate. Ruben is taking on MAGA extremist, Kari Lake, in Arizona to continue his fight for Arizona families in the Senate. Please read a message from him below:_
I won’t ever forget it, friend —
Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.
I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.
And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick.
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.
I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.
I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.
**[Please split a donation of $5 — that or anything you can give — between my campaign and The Long Run to crush Kari Lake’s campaign and defend our democracy.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-gallego-split.yaQa6D&refcode=em24327-1-tt&t=1&akid=5254%2E196590%2EnfhovH)

Ruben

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Across the country—and especially here in Houston—we are watching March Madness, cheering on our teams, inspired by their heart and their skills.
In Washington, it’s March Madness of another kind. The good news is, we did pass spending bills and fund the government. The bad news is, it took more than six months to do the very basics of governing—keeping the government funded and functioning, with shutting it down threatened at every moment. And, as soon as a bipartisan group of members (including me) voted to fund the government, another House Republican filed a motion to remove the Speaker of the House.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240327?refcode=lpfe240327 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240327?refcode=lpfe240327]
This kind of madness is not the good kind. And it’s also not limited to March. We’ve seen a lot of headlines like these over the past year.

Everything House Republicans have done—or in most instances, failed to do—since taking over the majority is a reminder of how important it is to elect responsible leaders. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240327?refcode=lpfe240327]
From the ever-threatened government shutdowns, to the baseless impeachments, to the bills abandoned to appease Donald Trump, House Republicans have shown us how they govern—or fail to govern.
It doesn’t have to be this way. It wasn’t this way the past few years when Democrats controlled the House. We were focused on governing responsibly, meeting the needs of the American people, and working across the aisle whenever we could.
This team is fighting to not only win our #TX07 race but to also win back the House majority so we can return to leadership that’s focused on getting the things done that Americans want done.
We are going to keep doing that work through November, and your contributions make that possible. We have an important FEC deadline this Sunday. If you are able to contribute and help us keep our campaign efforts going, I would be so grateful. It all adds up, and it all makes a difference. Together, we can do anything,

I bet we all are feeling it. So much of our democracy is at stake this year. But I can't help but think about how this grassroots team has shown it's up to the task — how we've helped secure big, game-changing wins in the fight for fair maps. There's a lot of work to do to defend our democracy in the months ahead. **So let me ask:[Can you donate now to help the NDRC reach our $30,000 end-of-quarter goal to help win the fight for fair maps?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81788024/463512057/176388959?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_marfun_email_20240327-NDRC-Red-EOQ1_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240327-NDRC-Red-EOQ1_&utm_campaign=marfun&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVjN2IxY2IwLTdkZWMtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VQCL7WjhXyFCChXw9k13v70LJsjmRm2AXaAt2AzB5rA=)** We are at a crossroads. One path, paved with fairness, leads to a future in which everyone is equally represented in our nation’s democracy. The other, paved with political greed and opportunism, promises a future where extremist politicians can bend the rules in their favor to subvert the will of hardworking voters. **The decisions we make and the actions we take in the coming months will determine which path we tread.[Your contribution right now will help ensure we have the resources we need to meet this moment head on — please chip in right now.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81788025/463512058/176388959?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_marfun_email_20240327-NDRC-Red-EOQ1_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240327-NDRC-Red-EOQ1_&utm_campaign=marfun&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVjN2IxY2IwLTdkZWMtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VQCL7WjhXyFCChXw9k13v70LJsjmRm2AXaAt2AzB5rA=)** I won’t sugarcoat the truth: we already face an uphill battle. Several states — including crucial battlegrounds like Florida, North Carolina, and Texas — entered the new year with racially and politically biased maps. At the same time, anti-democratic forces are still advancing legal challenges that threaten to undermine the Voting Rights Act of 1965 — the _crown jewel_ of the civil rights movement. name: Josh Harder
subject: Not another “doom and gloom” political email
body:
Telling it like it is.

Peter,
You know I hate “doom and gloom” political emails, so I’m just going to tell it like it is and hope you understand.
The final election results for the primary just came in, and we lost to the Republicans. The combined GOP vote total is now over 50%. This comes just days after a new poll showed us down by 4 points in a head-to-head matchup against my Republican opponent Kevin Lincoln.
**As a result, we had to raise our end-of-quarter goal by $10,000 before the deadline on Sunday and now we’re falling behind!**
Can I count on you to make a donation to my campaign so we can fight back and keep this seat blue? I don’t take corporate PAC donations so I’m counting on the incredible support of this grassroots army to reach our goal.
Here’s my link if you can contribute today: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-March2024-FR-March**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81788871/463514680/2012216730?&refcode=E7724-20240327-PersonalEOQ-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMGM2NDMxYWUtODBlYy1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0V3QBQqT0hucG276_ZUKfpnj7WTygHmN74nPmme6lo8=)

clean_body: Squeezing American families until they turn blue | | | | Congressional Republicans just released a big budget proposal. I am wholly opposed to it. Here is why: On Social Security. Instead of having America's wealthiest pay their fair share in taxes, their big idea is to raise the retirement age for Social Security. This is the big Republican idea? To milk even more out of our working-class families? They seem intent on doing everything they can to stick it to everyday American workers, all to line the pockets of the billionaires who fund their campaigns. On Reproductive Freedom. First, let me make this very clear: I believe the right to reproductive health care should be protected. Full stop. But look here at this budget proposal: Republicans are lining up to support a full ban on reproductive freedoms , birth control, and just about any reasonable access to a safe and legal abortion (and even to IVF). MAGA extremists promised to do anything to overturn Roe v. Wade. They got that done after stacking the Supreme Court with extreme voices. Now they are trying to take the next step. Republicans have shown that their plan is to repeal the ACA and gut the meaningful progress we have made in the last few decades on issues ranging from civil rights to environmental protections. The bottom line is that this coming November election matters. name: Jon Tester
subject: This is what we’re working with
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
I _hate_ asking for money, Peter. I know you have better things to do than read these emails. But can I explain?
Campaigns cost money. _A lot of money._ I wish they didn’t, but this is what we’re working with. And if we want to continue getting stuff done in the Senate, then I need to win this election. Plain and simple.
The GOP is already hammering me with vicious attacks. They’re trying to turn me into someone I’m not — **because they can’t beat who I am.**

On the latest SCOTUS case

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1976%2E4032634%2EqZj-An)
---
The Supreme Court just heard a case on whether to restrict access to mifepristone — an FDA-approved medication that abortion patients have used for decades. Before I continue, a few important things to make clear: Mifepristone was approved 20 years ago by the FDA. It has been used safely and effectively in all that time. Half of all abortions in this country are medication abortions. So this case is not about the safety of the medication. It’s about extremist, partisan politics, plain and simple. This will be the biggest abortion case to be decided by the Supreme Court since _Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization_ — the case that overturned _Roe v. Wade._ As a former law professor, I have to say that if I were to grade the legal argument in the majority opinion in the _Dobbs_ case, it would get an F. Since then, states have tried to make it extremely difficult to access this medication — or have banned it altogether. Anti-abortion extremists’ next crusade is to ban mifepristone nationwide, and they’ve also got plans to ban birth control too. Yep, birth control. The Supreme Court hearing this case just makes the already-obvious even more painfully obvious: Overturning _Roe_ was never simply about “leaving abortion policy to the states.” Right-wing extremists and MAGA Republicans are attacking national abortion access at every angle, everywhere, with a national abortion ban on the top of their wish list. [**I’m going to continue to pull every lever I can to protect abortion access in our country. If you’re able to, please donate $28 or anything you can to support our pro-abortion rights campaign so we can continue to fight back against extremists trying to take away our freedoms.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1931?amount=28&t=8&akid=1976%2E4032634%2EqZj-An)

It’s infuriating that we’re in this position. It’s outrageous that a handful of unelected Supreme Court justices ripped a constitutional right away from over half our population, and extremists are pressing forward to restrict access even more. I’m still angry, and I’m still determined to fight back. Right-wing extremists were able to overturn _Roe_ because of years and years and years of planning — and we’ve got to do whatever it takes, for as long as it takes, to undo the damage they’ve done. ### Big News for Florida:
---
_This past weekend in Brevard County, Congressman Bill Posey’s campaign hosted Congressman Jim Jordan, a conservative champion serving as Chairman of the U.S. House Judiciary Committee._
---
[](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-250-570-963-5ee418aab8-5n21032111)
---
“**We are working hard to bring people together to build a larger, stronger, conservative Republican House majority** that will hold the Washington swamp accountable and put America first policies front and center,“ said Congressman Bill Posey. “It’s great to see so many friends and neighbors actively engaged in this effort to fight for America’s future.” During the well-attended event, Congressman Jordan praised Congressman Posey’s courageous leadership and faithfulness to Florida’s voters: “There are people like Bill Posey who you are glad chose public service... What you tell the voters you were going to do when you put your name on the ballot when you ran—if they elect you—go do what you said. And Bill does that every single day.” Congressman Posey will continue to fight for Florida—and for your family. We need people in Congress who are doing the work and fighting for us. Not for donors, not for big corporations, but for us. Brattleboro is where this journey started for me, and it’s this community that gives me the strength and hope that I take to Congress each time I step foot in the Capitol. As you know, I announced this morning that I’m officially running for re-election to Congress. (= or keep reading to learn why.) I believe our leaders should be focused on alleviating suffering and fighting for people on the margins. I grew up knowing what it was like to be on the outside. I grew up knowing I was gay and that this wasn’t accepted in my community. And as a teacher, I wanted to ensure that no child felt disconnected or alone. I took the big leap of running for Congress to serve regular people: Working families trying to support their kids, farmers working the land, and small businesses that hold our economy together. We need people in Congress who are doing the work and fighting for us. Not for donors, not for big corporations, but for us. In my freshman term, I’ve been so proud to lift up the voices of regular people and represent Vermonters on some of the most pressing issues in our state. [ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, while the
Biden administration meets with Israel's Defense Minister, who has a “long
wish list” of weapons, Bernie is advocating for the clear moral choice.
Bernie’s saying no more weapons or funding for Netanyahu’s war. Bernie’s
calling for an immediate end to Israel’s blockade of humanitarian aid for
Gaza.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16384?t=1011&akid=5657%2E5885482%2EHXP9Uv ][IMG]

As Bernie wrote to President Biden recently, Israel’s restrictions on
humanitarian aid violate international law. And any further U.S. funding
and weapons in support of Netanyahu’s atrocities would violate U.S. law —
the Foreign Assistance Act bars military support from going to any nation
that restricts the delivery of humanitarian aid.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16385?source=email-20240327&t=1012&akid=5657%2E5885482%2EHXP9Uv ]Stand with Bernie: Not another dime for Netanyahu’s war. No more U.S.
weapons to bomb Gaza.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16385?source=email-20240327&t=1013&akid=5657%2E5885482%2EHXP9Uv ]ADD YOUR NAME

As Bernie said on MSNBC recently: no matter what propaganda is coming from
Netanyahu’s government, it is crystal clear that Israel is blocking aid to
Gaza.

Yet, the U.S. State Department is following along with Netanyahu’s
propaganda despite reports from the United Nations, Human Rights Watch,
OxFam, and others showing that Israel is blocking food, water, and medical
aid.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16384?t=1014&akid=5657%2E5885482%2EHXP9Uv ][IMG]

“To pretend that Israel is not violating international law or interfering
with U.S. humanitarian aid is absurd on its face,” Bernie said.

Children are starving and people are dying because of American made
weapons and failed American policy. President Biden has sent Israel more
than $570 million of weapons since the bombing campaign against Gaza began
five and a half months ago.

President Biden and Congress must listen to Bernie. No more American
weapons and taxpayer dollars for the war on Gaza.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16385?source=email-20240327&t=1015&akid=5657%2E5885482%2EHXP9Uv ]Stand with Bernie: End U.S. complicity in the brutal war on Gaza.
President Biden and Congress must end all support for Netanyahu’s war and
Israel’s severe restrictions on humanitarian aid to Gaza.

| | | Peter, Did you know that there are 69 cop cities popping up all over the United States since 2020?1 They call them "public safety training facilities," but let's call a spade a spade, right? After all of the uprisings in 2020, there's been a major push to militarize the police even more and get them ready for any future mass protests. **What we’re looking at isn’t just an Atlanta Cop City problem. We’re looking at a Cop Nation Project.** And now our fight for democracy in Atlanta has reached a critical moment. **[To fuel this crucial mission, we need your support. Your contribution today will go directly towards our efforts to challenge signature matching, fight for fair representation, and secure a place for the Cop City referendum on the ballot so that we can once and for all let the people decide.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqssRMyxDPkvhdihIAvPpi8wLvG9KeM8-MT5iOLOd8AATA1IaGk-wKpzP90AzRTKNZ_oBlTe8EZfu8SmMq9dPc_cXjTEaeLwxuRoXURCN7pIIeRLPh6mP9B4yoGJ8eW0Y4zpN9MRzsTuSYW759WPzmfZSI8yG7MK9omPKqwyaNFiw-SRYEcmMfjGvyxLP81_jWIkxEDKxjXh166as4nl-3XmDDv7uwXHuCucP0u8GFVKw9mbiKo9H__RaQ3LUtX5SuXYiGBL9OptcNaeH0Rb6mDY4qBpkVqTES1Pb-yOCXHH6NGJ1LckUR4ekVjZMPYYwl4PHzUo-8wravKBM48xXBSeQm94HRbjAEwECidfleEAuQ/450/lbLBPRIRSwyNheCNq8Hy9w/h0/h001._l5uLvO3CLrY7kKB3oZl25Krskophtib1ZQgrNWnmqY)** **[Donate to join the fight](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqssRMyxDPkvhdihIAvPpi8wLvG9KeM8-MT5iOLOd8AATA1IaGk-wKpzP90AzRTKNZ_oBlTe8EZfu8SmMq9dPc_c6_YlpbrcasqptMhFU50fuj3UQbCG2wdEa12HoVsRRna_tfChIpyk4S-4_zAQKAMsxlscGbC0lPfu1ILWpcZKmIHshpX9K-Lmblxtnhs9uqweaAXfJ_ZEDin2StenS3R4el0IGvSfYmi4bZHkclrcTzXsnnexxO8ieafJzxQ-oXw1DCRdnxFcWbSqbok4lwx-pxnImsTI9xepcTvlTQrOqLbSOQih5AIaJ-Tc8AKOZStIaRO2LWb0u57iSep5i3PzuyS2nchOnBpYA-OryfWAGA/450/lbLBPRIRSwyNheCNq8Hy9w/h1/h001._FBSBWRZtIWmbyXCvV_WWHmdSKPFFVBiN2c2PPUhlY4)** The right to petition our government is a cornerstone of our democratic principles, allowing citizens to voice their concerns and influence public policy. So, when the City of Atlanta delays and obstructs the processing of 116,000 signatures demanding a referendum, democracy is undermined along with the will of the people. Ensuring that every citizen’s voice is heard and that their concerns are addressed is not just a matter of civic duty but a fundamental right that we need to safeguard. **See, this is more than a referendum; it's about the core of our democratic values and holding our elected officials accountable.** In February, the Atlanta City Council finally voted to codify a process by which they can verify the signatures we collected last summer. And after many passionate appeals from activists like myself within the chambers, the motion to remove signature match from the bill failed. And with it, the establishment of a transparent and fair process for referendums, including the Cop City referendum. The final vote with only four members of the council in opposition to this anti-democratic ordinance is a stark reminder of the lawmakers who turned their backs on their constituents. **But here's the silver lining: our chance for change is on the horizon.** For nearly six months, the City of Atlanta has neglected its duty to process the 116,000 signatures we collected last summer urging a referendum on Cop City. Despite the city charter's mandate, the council has hidden behind legal excuses, denying Atlantans their First Amendment right to petition the government. What we need now is for Mayor Andre Dickens to drop the lawsuit that is holding up the verification process and begin verifying those 116,000 signatures immediately. After that, we hope to see a question about Cop City on the ballot for Atlantans to decide what to do with nearly $120 million of taxpayer money. **We will persist in our fight to put Cop City on the ballot, and once it’s there, we’re going to be ready to show up for our community once again to ensure that every Atlantans’ voice is heard.** While the Atlanta City Council has failed in supporting voters, we, the people, have to show up and once again do the work to cure the signatures when the time inevitably comes. **[Together, we can ensure that the voices of the people prevail over attempts to suppress our democratic rights. Peter,

Our campaign has sent a lot of fundraising emails lately -- more than I wish we had to send. So I wanted to take a moment to explain what these messages mean to our campaign, and why you're seeing more of them from us (and likely many others) than usual.

In just a few days, we close the books on the first official quarterly FEC fundraising deadline of our campaign for Senate.

When it ends, we all report how much money we've raised and those results will be looked at with a fine-tooth comb by the press, our opponents and even potential allies.

What we report is widely viewed as an indicator of our campaign's strength. The numbers have the ability to invite attacks if opponents think we are weak, or encourage our allies to do more to help us win if they are strong.

But the numbers we want to reach are also very real goals. They are numbers we need to reach in order to win.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6b5e771c56744ef7873a54fa4f86a579&_e=dwWWKU9EJw1aRv_9ulKOfrx-RZ-3ItiyaV7lbL8zTkgOQeqqipSsH_A-2VPfuGI53LqtAXG3BSQO2XCWWFnG5SrCUxVLf4c6omX3mRinJY_VNv1BUzeMbsgiPn23JdgQVgmObeIIlDZp6Gj2A0uJagbU6kjY2Q8YpI_o0f4kmM-Q5aXLHTdee7Hlrn1G_C4-1RBpKEMVyAso8caXdAMBKltUNHzBl3dvuccdQRDjUQsVKr1Ta_q-91ljLv3t18rDXaWwLOWVoxLgCIvGGKO7511W9o2wPQA7_x7jyfPIQjVGWWqrwXWnxs53OGqrJV1-SwaNcwetYnMOXoZtSHK1isfJjXtwGktym7jDUkEqhMbGDjvI9ENQM4kzKU3ZDkqwI03wFPEb5kNsdtxQ1vQL3qxbdA60mLsuwUleS0FDUFS8NlkygRLA_UXH0qYLy3li).

name: Senator Eva Burch
subject: Why I Shared My Abortion Story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Engel for Arizona Engel for Arizona
body:
No one should have to justify their abortions to any politician. My story is not uncommon, but with extreme Republicans' relentless attacks on abortion access and reproductive freedoms| | |
---
| | Peter, On the Arizona Senate Floor, I shared that my pregnancy was non-viable and that I was making the decision to have an abortion. It's not a moment that anyone wants to share, but I knew my story needed to be told. My story is not uncommon, but with extreme Republicans' relentless attacks on abortion access and reproductive freedoms, access to care around the country has been threatened. We must show Republicans that their attempts to interfere in these deeply personal matters should be left to a patient, their family, and their doctor. But we need more people in power who will push back against these extreme policies and instead guarantee that every person has the autonomy to make their own decisions for their reproductive health. **[Please, split a $5 or $10 donation between Kirsten Engel's and my campaign. My story is not uncommon, but with extreme Republicans' relentless attacks on abortion access and reproductive freedoms| | | | | Peter, On the Arizona Senate Floor, I shared that my pregnancy was non-viable and that I was making the decision to have an abortion. It's not a moment that anyone wants to share, but I knew my story needed to be told. My story is not uncommon, but with extreme Republicans' relentless attacks on abortion access and reproductive freedoms, access to care around the country has been threatened. We must show Republicans that their attempts to interfere in these deeply personal matters should be left to a patient, their family, and their doctor. Friend,
_Abortion is under attack in America._
In less than two years, since Roe v. Wade was overturned, we've watched our country be pushed backward to an era of extreme bans, dangerous policies, and attacks on patients and doctors. In my home state, abortion is now banned after a mere 15 weeks. But evidently, that already extreme, unpopular ban wasn't enough for Ron DeSantis: **_He's also signed a six-week ban, which could take effect in the next few months._**
We're seeing a similar story play out in states across the country. Far-right legislators are pushing bills to criminalize abortion procedures, threaten doctors, undermine access to birth control, ban interstate travel to access abortion care, and so much more. **The Alabama Supreme Court has even issued a ruling that jeopardizes access to IVF treatment!**
**Now, Rick Scott and his extreme allies are scheming to ban abortions nationwide.**
The Republican Party is _wildly_ out of step with the American public — and they know it. That's why they're working overtime to block a new ballot initiative that would give voters the chance to restore reproductive rights here in Florida.
The 2024 elections will mark a turning point in this fight. This November is our chance to defend and strengthen our pro-choice majority in the Senate. But it's also Rick Scott's chance to become the GOP Senate Majority Leader and ban abortions nationwide.
I'm running to defeat Rick Scott, protect our Senate majority, and restore abortion access across the country. **A brand new poll shows that our campaign has pulled ahead as Rick Scott's approval ratings continue to plummet. subject: My testimony
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia
body:
| | | Brothers and Sisters, **“****Here am I. Send me!” Isaiah 6:8** I have always tried to be obedient to the Lord Peter, because He has always been faithful to me. Even when I was diving hundreds of feet into the ocean or defusing bombs on the battlefield as a U.S. Navy officer, I knew the Lord was by my side. _But it was a long path to get to my faith._ **Let me start with my testimony.** I was born into a Buddhist family and grew up in Muslim countries in West Africa. I always knew there was a God, but I never knew He wanted a relationship with me. But all along, God was there. He made a pathway for our family to escape Communist Vietnam and start a new life in America. In this strange new world, I had a lot of incredible opportunities – including being accepted to the U.S. Naval Academy to serve the country that saved my life. I was ready for all the challenges the Navy would bring... **...But then I failed out!**** ** Just like that, all of my hopes and dreams were gone. I couldn’t understand it. But a voice inside my head told me that I would be back. I didn’t know how. No one comes back to the Naval Academy once they are disenrolled. I enrolled in college back home and did everything I could to get my way back to Annapolis. I made the Dean’s list every semester. But the answer from the Academy was the same every time I reapplied - no! That was when a close mentor told me he had a strong belief through prayer, that I would make it back to the Academy. And when I said it was impossible, he told me about Jesus and how He always makes a way even when there doesn’t seem one. I was introduced to a God that loved me so much, He gave His life for me. So I gave my life to Him. **A few months later, the impossible happened: I was one of the first to be re-accepted to the United States Naval Academy. I never took anything for granted again, and I put my trust in Jesus.** Six years after I re-entered the Naval Academy and graduated, I re-connected with a woman I knew from my time back home in Virginia, and we’ve been married for more than 25 years and have five beautiful children. **I had to get kicked out of the Naval Academy to find God and find my wife.** Since that moment, I never questioned the Lord my God. When He says, “Whom shall I send. And who will go for Us?” I say “Here I am! Send me.” So when I heard a voice inside me telling me to retire from the military and run for office, I did not question it. I left a 25 year career I absolutely loved to answer God’s new call to service. I left a life of honor in the military with the hope of bringing honor back into the U.S. Senate. This is a tough fight, but as a Christian, I know Christ already won the war. We are called to be obedient and endure the battles until the end. I ask you to stand with me, a servant of our Lord and Savior, and help me bring our country back to victory in God’s image.

I first ran for Congress to deliver tangible results for my community in MN-02. That’s why I’m incredibly grateful every time I’m reminded of what an impact the work I do makes.

Recently, I ran into a constituent in Cottage Grove who now takes his insulin regularly because my bill last Congress capped the cost at $35 a month for our nation's seniors on Medicare.

Folks like him are counting on members of Congress to go to bat for _them_ — not for Big Pharma or other corporate interests.

From fighting to lower the cost of insulin for all Americans who need it, to working to stop price gouging and end the fentanyl crisis, I will always put the health of the people I represent first.

But Big Pharma has spent big against me in past races, and the pharmaceutical industry spent significantly more than any other industry to try to influence members of Congress last year.

clean_body: I first ran for Congress to deliver tangible results for my community in MN-02. = = = I first ran for Congress to deliver tangible results for my community in MN-02. That’s why I’m incredibly grateful every time I’m reminded of what an impact the work I do makes. Recently, I ran into a constituent in Cottage Grove who now takes his insulin regularly because my bill last Congress capped the cost at $35 a month for our nation's seniors on Medicare. Folks like him are counting on members of Congress to go to bat for them — not for Big Pharma or other corporate interests. From fighting to lower the cost of insulin for all Americans who need it, to working to stop price gouging and end the fentanyl crisis, I will always put the health of the people I represent first. But Big Pharma has spent big against me in past races, and the pharmaceutical industry spent significantly more than any other industry to try to influence members of Congress last year. We need to take back the House to deliver more progress and make sure Republicans don’t have the votes they need to overturn the Affordable Care Act , cut Medicare and further attack healthcare access. = All the best, Angie | Paid for by Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress Contributions or gifts to Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress are not tax deductible. Hey! In case we haven’t met, I’m Sarah Lane, and I’m the Executive Director here at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. Jane and I believe in full transparency, and we want to keep you informed about everything happening in and around the organization. There have been a lot of moving parts so I wanted to clue you in on what we’ve been up to. First off, we hired two new staff members! This would not have been possible without your support. We brought on a talented Director of Social Media who is working tirelessly to get the word out about our climate candidates and move folks to the polls. We also just hired a Field Program Manager to launch Jane PAC’s first-ever field organizing program. I’m a firm believer in investing in grassroots, door-to-door, field organizing. This is how we can turn out voters for down-ballot elections and move the needle on competitive races. We will be recruiting volunteers to go door-to-door in critical races to help our climate champions win BIG in November. While we’re scaling up to go bigger than ever before, we are a bit short of our end-of-quarter fundraising goal. **But here’s some good news: We’ve secured a commitment from an anonymous donor who will match every donation dollar for dollar up to $15,000 towards that goal. This match is a great opportunity to double your impact and help us meet our crucial target.** **Here’s where we stand on our goal right now:** | **Amount Raised** | **EOQ Goal** | **Need to Raise** | **% to Goal**

I am sure you’re already getting bombarded with plenty of campaign emails from all sorts of different candidates and organizations. I get it — it can be difficult to decide where to invest your hard-earned money.
**In our mission, every grassroots supporter like you is key. You are the driving force behind our work, and your involvement means the world to Jane, and to our entire team at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC.**
Jane PAC's mission is simple: replace the politicians who are deep in the pocket of the fossil fuel industry with climate champions who will fight like hell to move our country in the right direction.
The Jane Fonda Climate PAC works to elect climate champions all around the country, mostly in down-ballot races like state legislatures, mayors, city council members, and county executives that can have major impacts on climate action in their communities.
But Jane can’t do this work on her own; none of us can.

Peter - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

_Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth._

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=6110e7685f4248efaf0998bb8e6ccc20&_e=nW7PevGd6WphUqzzNMDmljA9NdY34yh8INGYN0PWl3awgR7Mh5ACx3r8nCrZ2_SMxVbwzqA_RBOZywyDCKY5cwy6JPi3DjIYANFzEkiE98wYGYE0UY4tFukOlHMWzqO4vlvq3PecDOhLYJVKtQeFdCsBZU4Cr8tzSNsxTR3UyY7poFN19_e5sUkYWlNMFkJ9BKWnUQDWe0GYhGpY5bTeAUAVes5dZ8rUOYxrwiJ6DFhKI6XQad0mWqJPOTUx6umZuzXCIKQ11fL9cxITLAfEknWyCLnWA6cmfA_QCG8o2CtF66caMMC9cgpMjvVmQ8Tp7rDflVCO_hkW7JgUIKgpTtnxTcjrb2cgDwJyp85rcC6l5QB19UEPFDIrOuXn4WiW_yM1Q5vXmPgkP3Cj2BKv_g%3D%3D)

[**But I’ll never stop fighting.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=6110e7685f4248efaf0998bb8e6ccc20&_e=nW7PevGd6WphUqzzNMDmljA9NdY34yh8INGYN0PWl3awgR7Mh5ACx3r8nCrZ2_SMxVbwzqA_RBOZywyDCKY5cwy6JPi3DjIYANFzEkiE98wYGYE0UY4tFukOlHMWzqO4vlvq3PecDOhLYJVKtQeFdCsBZU4Cr8tzSNsxTR3UyY7poFN19_e5sUkYWlNMFkJ9BKWnUQDWe0GYhGpY5bTeAUAVes5dZ8rUOYxrwiJ6DFhKI6XQad0mWqJPOTUx6umZkrUuw2mu6be5vtv7fMMisFUkpPuMfbzH4bqw_bpg86J134YqCvdDSYJkko-AGMgCvDRS5b1IJKMgYhU25ceW1zINR-FVn4oJUbiXbMKYY43PjmC4m8Oyj4CQVsm0ZNN4QRAx6o9lSEcWVDDD-9-iNw%3D%3D) I learned a long time ago that I have to fight for the things I believe in, _and I believe in America._

name: Jon Tester
subject: Can I explain?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I hate this.
I _hate_ asking for money, Derek. I know you have better things to do than read these emails. But can I explain?
Campaigns cost money. _A lot of money._ I wish they didn’t, but this is what we’re working with. And if we want to continue getting stuff done in the Senate, then I need to win this election. Plain and simple.
The GOP is already hammering me with vicious attacks. They’re trying to turn me into someone I’m not—**because they can’t beat who I am.**
That’s where you come in. Your donation helps us respond to dishonest attacks, fund our TV ads, and invest in voter outreach efforts. It makes a real difference in this race.
**So if you can,[will you split a donation before the end-of-quarter FEC deadline between my campaign and John Fetterman's? I appreciate whatever you can give because every dollar helps.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240327-1?refcode=em20240327-1-8865&refcode2=8865_434096_2O_r27&akid=8865%2E434096%2E2O_r27)**
